epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello and Goomo get into a very challenging project… Designing the perfect toy! A toy that has everything a kid would want, so great that you could never get tired of it. After developing some ideas theyll find out that that object is a lot closer t

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #66
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 里奧、姬蒂和英雄接獲傑登求助:他在救援被困河狸時陷入泥地,並遭遇熊。他們必須完成困難救援,並將河狸和家人團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leo, Katie, and Hero receive a call from Jayden who got stuck in the mud while trying to rescue a trapped beaver, leading to a challenging rescue mission involving a bear encounter and reuniting the beaver with its family.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #67
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲森林,珍發現外來的巨型非洲蝸牛正吃掉果樹,里奧和姬蒂協助捕捉並遷移這些蝸牛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the African forest, Jane alerts the Junior Rangers to invasive Giant African Snails devouring fruit trees which prompts Leo and Katie to help capture the snails and relocate them.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #68
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北非稀樹草原,珍發現一隻虛弱的普通翠鳥。里奧、姬蒂和英雄將牠移往河岸邊,並為牠搭建巢洞,以保護牠安全。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the North African Savanna, Jane finds a weakened Common Kingfisher, triggering a rescue mission by Leo, Katie, and Hero, leading them to relocate it to a riverbank and building it a burrow to keep it safe.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #69

epg.episode_synopsis_en: While exploring the Amazon Rainforest, Peyo stumbles upon a talking macaw that instructs him to follow it, leading the rangers on a wild jungle chase.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #70
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非海洋,少年遊俠原要拯救祖米免於鯊魚威脅,卻反而要從魚鉤中救出鯊魚尾巴被鉤住的鯊魚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the South African ocean, the rangers are on a mission to save Zumi from a shark threat but later find themselves having to rescue the shark from a fishing hook on its tail.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #71

epg.episode_synopsis_en: While exploring a coral reef, Kyle discovers an unfamiliar lionfish. This leads the Junior Rangers on an underwater adventure to relocate the lionfish and restore balance to the coral reef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 作為最後一個被選中進入球隊的人總是很慘。但如果你認為自己是最好的球員,而沒有選擇你的正是你自己最好的朋友,那就更慘了。這就是發生在比路身上的事情,他不能好好地接受它。

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #72
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在北美松林,少年遊俠在樹枝間救援一隻鹿角卡住的小魯道夫。他們的任務是把馴鹿送回原本的鹿群。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the North American pine forest, the rangers attempt to help a distressed Rudolph with antlers stuck between branche. Can they reunite the reindeer with its herd?

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #73
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非沙漠,珍和祖米發現沙漠雨蛙和被建設影響的巢穴,里奧、姬蒂和英雄協助將牠們遷至建築禁區,建立新巢穴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the South African desert, Jane and Zumi discover Desert Rain Frogs and their burrows displaced by construction. This leads to a mission with Leo, Katie, and Hero to relocate the frogs to a construction-free area where they can make new burrows.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #74
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在「瑪塔蛇頸龜任務」中,彼由與里奧、姬蒂和英雄一起將一隻復育後的龜送回牠的雨林棲地。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peyo, assisted by Leo, Katie and Hero undertakes The Mata-Mata Mission, to return a rehabilitated turtle to its rainforest habitat.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #75
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在加拿大森林徒步時,傑登發現一棵快倒的樹,樹洞中有袋貂寶寶。他們冒險進行救援,將負鼠寶寶從洞穴中救出並與母親團聚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While hiking in the Canadian forest, Jaydens discovery of a tree about to fall leads Leo, Katie, and Hero on a daring mission to rescue opossum babies from a hole beneath the tree.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #76

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores animals that like to travel.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rory is in the mood for dancing because this episode is all about animal’s feet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是世界上最大的動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the biggest animals in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人們在幾千年來一直建造令人驚嘆的建築……但有些動物更早就建造出瘋狂建築!今天的測驗是關於出色的動物建築師!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ttodays quiz is all about Brilliant Builders!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從前,人們在戰鬥時常常穿著盔甲來保護自己。許多動物仍然這樣做,這就是為何今天的測驗關於神奇裝甲動物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Today’s quiz is all about Amazing Armoured Animals!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有人為了讓他們的寵物更好看而十分努力!但野外的情況卻大相逕庭!奇妙的動物在沒有任何幫助下炫耀自己的東西,今天的測驗就是關於這些超級炫耀狂的。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Today’s quiz is all about the Super Show Offs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想看看世上正發生甚麼事時—我們用的是眼睛!但我們的眼睛絕對比不上某些動物的奇特視力!這就是為何今天的測驗全都關於優秀的眼球!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals with Excellent Eyeballs!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國王玩他最喜歡的謝維斯玩具,玩得正開心時,莉塔要求想玩。國王認為自己是一個很好的分享者,就讓給她。莉塔利用了國王的好心,很快就把他所有的玩具都騙走了!儘管莉塔一開始感到得意洋洋,但她的快樂卻短暫。莉塔必須發現玩具最好的地方;就是當你與他人分享時,你會獲得更多樂趣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The King is having a blast with his favorite Jelvis toy when Rita asks to play with it. King, who fancies himself a good sharer, let’s her. Rita takes advantage of the King and soon tricks him out of ALL his toys! Though Rita feels triumphant at firs

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 莉塔終於離渡渡鳥足夠接近來撫摸它—但只是因為牠弄傷了腳。她把這隻小動物帶回家,用愛餵養牠,還給牠吃太多的食物。現在超重的渡渡鳥非常需要運動。莉塔明白到所謂的關心,是要對他人有好處,而不是對自己有益。如此一來,現在有了一個新的好朋友。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rita finally gets close enough to a dodo to pet it---but only because it injured its foot. She takes the critter home, nursing it with affection and too much food. The now overweight dodo needs exercise badly. Rita learns that caring for others requi

epg.episode_synopsis_en: While exploring the musical nature of spring on Jammbo, Goomo realizes he has a fear of Burst into Song flowers. In search of a cure, Mina conducts a series of tests to help Goomo deal with his over the top reactions to the singing plants. In the end

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about China and the marvellous unique animals that you find there.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的是動物進食的不同方式。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about the different ways that animals eat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集我們將看看所有那些看起來很可愛但絕對不可愛的大型美麗動物。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode we’re taking a look at all those big beautiful animals that look cute but definitely not cuddly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述的都是動物,它們是我們最好的朋友、我們的幫手、我們的同伴和我們的夥伴。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode is all about animals that are our best friends our helpers our companions and our sidekicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 有些動物顏色鮮豔,很容易被看到。但今集我們要看的是喜歡匿藏的動物,這就是為何這個測驗全都關於偽裝大師!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Masters of Disguise!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們的腳幫助我們到達想去的地方。但動物可以用它們做出各種各樣的事。今天的測驗是關於神奇的腳!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Fantastic Feet!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 它很臭。它很粘。它很髒。它是一個沼澤。你應該不想住在那裡—但許多奇妙的動物都把它稱為家。這就是為何今天的測驗關於沼澤的大小事!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about Swamp Things!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物有各種各樣的顏色—但只有一種真正鶴立雞群!對,今天的測驗是關於紅色-紅色-紅色的動物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Todays quiz is all about animals that are red!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孩子們初次去外太空旅行並見到太空人先生的女兒。阿添對女孩的固有印象受到衝擊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children travel to Outer Space to meet Mr. Astronauts daughter for the first time. Tims perception of what girls are like is challenged.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿斯池特養了一隻新小狗。孩子們幫她訓練小狗,以參加這個世界以外的狗展比賽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The children help Astrid train her puppy for a dog show competition that is out of this world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 比路發現他最好的朋友有音樂天賦。從那一刻起,他將嘗試與其他朋友分享發現。儘管姑毛很害羞,比路還是會嘗試揭露和分享這個秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bello discovers his best friend has an innate talent for music. From that moment on, he will try to share his discovery with the rest of his friends. Despite how shy Goomo is, Bello will try to reveal and share the secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《小毛孩大百科》能解答小孩們一直喜愛的動物的疑問。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: ZooMooPedia answers the questions kids have always wanted to know about their favourite animals

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盧賓浩了解到保持海灘清潔的重要性。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lubinho learns the importance of keeping the beach clean.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 穿上你的舞鞋,準備好與 ZooMoosic 一起跳舞吧!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strap on your dancing shoes and get ready to boogie with ZooMoosic.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #57
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在巴拉瓜納半島,彼由與皮可發現一隻正在蛻殼的狼蛛,有驚險但和平的「蛻變」任務由里奧、姬蒂和英雄協助觀察。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Paraguana Peninsula, Peyo and Pico finds a tarantula in distress and with Leo, Katie, and Heros help, they learn that the tarantula is molting.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #58
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南加州沙漠,傑登看到一隻塑膠蜥蜴,後來被公路飛羽帶走。里奧、姬蒂和英雄進行追逐任務,混亂橫越沙漠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Southern Californian desert, Jayden sees a plastic lizard before it is taken by a roadrunner, prompting a mission by Leo, Katie, and Hero to retrieve it, ensuing a chaotic chase across the desert.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #59
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在墨西哥,彼由與皮可在一個混濁水域遇見一隻缺三條腿的墨西哥招潮魚。他們動員里奧、姬蒂和英雄救援並將當地所有這種魚遷移到更乾淨的區域。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Mexico, Peyo and Pico encounter a three-legged axolotl in a murky lake, prompting a rescue mission for Leo, Katie, and Hero, to relocate all the axolotls in the lake to a cleaner area.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #60
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南美雨林,彼由的國際營地夜遭浣熊偷走他的背包,啟動里奧、姬蒂和英雄尋找背包任務。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the South American rainforest, Peyos International Campout Night takes a turn when his satchel is stolen by a kinkajou, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to retrieve it.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #61
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當傑登在加勒比海撿到一隻被風箏線纏住的鸚哥魚,里奧、姬蒂和英雄啟動任務,在珊瑚礁附近解救受困魚。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When Jayden picks up a discarded kite in the Caribbean Sea, he discovers an entagled parrotfish, leading Leo, Katie, and Hero on a mission to free the fish near a coral reef.

epg.programme_title_tc: 野生遊俠里奧 第3季 #62
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲草原,珍和祖米的友誼競賽變危險,祖米被毒性蝰蛇咬傷,緊急救援展開。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Lukes vampire companions track him down...

epg.programme_title_tc: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
epg.programme_title_en: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A female police officer relocates to a quiet small town and is drawn into a chilling case involving a girl seemingly possessed by an evil spirit. As her investigation deepens, unsettling truths emerge. She soon realises this is not just an exorcism, but a psychological battle that uncovers the town’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位記者調查二十年前紙人回魂案時,聽到三個關於恐怖紙人的故事。故事起源於喬府大小姐喬媛媛枉死後,管家請紙紮匠為小姐做了紙人陪葬。紙人被點眼睛後,大小姐得以借紙人回魂復仇,更接二連三引發連串與紙人有關的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lonely widow Joyce rents out a room in her house and becomes dangerously obsessed with a younger guest. Desperate for love, she is willing to eliminate anyone hindering her pursuit of happiness, and a chilling tale of obsession unfolds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 若為和兩位閨蜜回到她兒時居住的房子,重遇一直住在那兒的表哥。他們本打算一起散散心,卻頻頻遭遇靈異事件的侵襲,最後更變成一場驚心動魄之旅,有讓人意想不到的結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸淩同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸淩,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 父親去世後,Nathan和妹妹回到祖家準備出售房子。在此期間,Nathan發現這處房產是從兩名曾被指控濫用巫術的女子的祖先手中偷來的。隨著他深入調查,揭開了一個與父親死亡相關的神秘陰謀,而這個陰謀如今..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their fathers death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their fathers death which now threatens them both.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Single mother Yu Xiang and her daughter Tong Tong move into a neighbourhood where every family appears to live a perfect life. Beneath the idyllic façade lie hidden secrets. As tensions and suspicion grow, buried fears, anxieties and the darkest sides of human nature emerge, trapping the mother and daughter in a psychological nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 單親媽媽郁香與女兒童童搬進一個住宅區展開新生活。區內每個家庭看似幸福美滿,背後卻藏著不為人知的秘密。隨著鄰里間的矛盾與猜忌逐漸浮現,人們內心深處的恐懼、不安與人性黑暗面也被一一揭開,母女二人也逐漸陷入..

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 單親媽媽郁香與女兒童童搬進一個住宅區展開新生活。區內每個家庭看似幸福美滿,背後卻藏著不為人知的秘密。隨著鄰里間的矛盾與猜忌逐漸浮現,人們內心深處的恐懼、不安與人性黑暗面也被一一揭開,母女二人也逐漸陷入..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Single mother Yu Xiang and her daughter Tong Tong move into a neighbourhood where every family appears to live a perfect life. Beneath the idyllic façade lie hidden secrets. As tensions and suspicion grow, buried fears, anxieties and the darkest sides of human nature emerge, trapping the mother and daughter in a psychological nightmare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A year after Jamies wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Amy和養子Adrian逃離了虐待她的前女友Judith,躲在Amy堪薩斯家鄉的一棟廢棄農舍中,卻遭遇到因Amy的暗黑歷史所引發的邪惡超自然力量,讓Adrian感到恐懼。當Judith步步進逼時,Am..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amys Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 資深主播艾米遭遇詭異蝙蝠襲擊後,帶著傷口返回電台,準備主持當晚的深夜節目。豈料竟遭無良老闆設局解僱,並被新人強行取代。適逢暴風雨封鎖整座電台,隨著傷口引發的異變愈演愈烈,艾米逐漸失控,在直播間掀起一場..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Radio host Amy is bitten by a mysterious bat, but she returns to the station to host that night’s late-night show. Instead, she is set up and fired by her ruthless boss, then replaced by a newcomer. As a violent storm traps everyone in the station and her mysterious wound worsens, Amy gradually loses control and unleashes a bloody massacre.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 副警長James奉命看守一具曾舉行神秘儀式的女屍。豈料,他因一時好奇誤觸未完成的邪惡儀式,讓禁忌之門大開,釋放出三個黑暗惡魔。在精神廢墟、幻覺與真實邪祟的瘋狂夾擊下,他的理智逐步瓦解,最終墜入無法逃離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.programme_title_tc: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2 (aka Offspring of the Devils Pact 2)
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒Azlinda從小就受到鬼魂的困擾,相信這些折磨與父母的暗黑歷史密切相關。她的朋友Zurina、Wati和Ustaz攜手合作,希望結束她的痛苦,但卻被一個邪惡的惡魔阻撓。Azlinda能否成功斬斷..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在朋友去世後,一群年輕人前往倫敦郊外的一座別墅,這裡隱藏著撲朔迷離的謎團。隨著度假期間詭異事件不斷發生,他們必須揭開別墅深藏的黑暗秘密。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個寧靜的晚上,一名患精神病的連環殺手擾亂了年輕夫婦的平淡生活。當這對夫婦為生存而戰時,他們隱藏多年的秘密亦隨之揭開,期間更意外地被牽連到黑社會的地下世界中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young couples tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 盂蘭時節,一位無視傳統的職場新人第一天上班即禍從口出,得罪了辦公樓裡的鬼魂。值夜班的過程中,連累同事們一同經歷了許多詭異事件,令他們重新反思自己的不敬行為和對神明的態度。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在迷霧村,為人養子的文傑反復夢見同一個噩夢。為了解開身世之謎,他捲入連串神秘的失蹤案件中。隨著更多村民相繼離奇死去,村民更深信不疑千年來的井龍王詛咒。於是,文傑與保安隊長聯手探尋真相,揭開反派陰謀,最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When young Evie discovers a cursed necklace washed up on the beach, she is unaware of the malevolent force tied to it. As the necklaces dark power begins to grip her, she inadvertently awakens a deadly water demon intent on claiming her and everyone she holds dear.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
民國年間,江南村落接連發生離奇命案,逐漸淪為遠近聞名的鬼村「封門村」。記者李穆與員警萬楓為追查一宗滅門慘案,深入陰森村莊抽絲剝繭,
誓要揭開連環命案背後的真相,破除流傳已久的封建迷信。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the Republican era, a Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes the infamous ghost village of Fengmen. Journalist Li Mu and police officer Wan Feng venture into the eerie village to uncover the truth behind the killings and shatter the grip of superstition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 五名大學生受委派前往一座神祕莊園進行專題研究,並結識了上流名媛莎拉吉夫人,卻發現她隱藏著致命祕密。隨著她的惡魔力量逐漸覺醒,原本的學術之旅瞬間化為生死逃亡,他們必須對抗統治階層延續數百年的詛咒。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Five university students are assigned a project at a mysterious estate, where they meet Lady Salakjit, an elite socialite with a deadly secret. As her demonic powers surface, their academic trip turns into a frantic struggle for survival against a centuries-old curse of the ruling class.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After their young daughter’s mysterious disappearance, Drew and Helen retreat to a secluded woodland cottage for therapy. As they struggle to salvage their marriage, isolation fractures their sanity. Haunted by visions and strange events, Helen can no longer tell what is real as her mind unravels.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After moving into a house with her boyfriend, Gun, architect May learns of her stepmother’s mysterious death. When May takes in her stepsister Noon, the girl begins showing signs of possession, while May suffers disturbing visions and insomnia. As dark secrets emerge, spiritual masters uncover an ancient black-magic curse hidden within the house.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 藝人尹青透過一個靈異電視節目闖入地獄之門,並與已故好友美琪重逢。在美琪的墓園,尹青遇見了美琪的丈夫東升,隨後一系列詭異的靈異事件接連發生。尹青將東升帶回節目,讓美琪揭露了丈夫的婚外情和導致她死亡的陰謀..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Artiste Yin Qing enters Hells Gate through a supernatural TV show and reunites with her late friend Mei Qi. At Mei Qis gravesite, Yin Qing encounters Mei Qis husband, Dong Sheng, and a series of mysterious incidents unfold. She then brings Dong Sheng onto the show, where Mei Qi exposes his infidelity and reveals the conspiracy behind her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場車禍後,林月家裡怪事連連。全身冰冷的姐姐在鏡子裡看不見家人的身影,黑夜裡爸爸窺探的雙眼,和每天淩晨閣樓傳來的彈珠聲。林月循聲而上去尋找真相,卻在打開閣樓的門後,發現裡面緊鎖的是自己的遺像…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yues house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位渴望成名的作家為了挽救低迷的事業,決心創作一部暢銷小說。他重返童年故居,這裡亦是其身為知名作家的父親當年神秘身亡之地。當他意外發現父親留下的最後手稿時,才驚覺這部作品遠超自己的才華。於是,他決定將..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個不斷以自己的標準審判別人的司機,總是用自己的方式默默為他人著想,試圖救贖一個又一個在他眼中的“受害者。當他心儀的女性朋友似被其兒子利用,他不惜擅行私刑,漸漸成為冷血的連環殺手…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美國加州Ojai鎮流傳著一處神秘的「惡魔漩渦」,據說凡是踏入其禁地的人,都將被黑暗力量吞噬。六段彼此交織的恐怖故事,逐步揭開這股邪惡力量的真相,以及一棟遭受詛咒的房屋與歷代住戶無法逃離的駭人命運。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ojai, California, a mysterious spiritual vortex is said to unleash dark forces upon anyone who enters its domain. Through six interconnected horror tales, the terrifying secrets of a cursed house and its doomed inhabitants are revealed, exposing the sinister power lurking behind the Devils Vortex.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 四名好友在一座古老宅邸重聚,出席一場葬禮,因一時魯莽觸碰被詛咒的瑪諾拉舞者頭飾,意外喚醒如影隨形的厲鬼。隨著靈異現象接連發生,他們被迫揭開宅邸深藏的黑暗秘密,在絕望中展開一場與惡靈的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When four best friends reunite for a funeral at an ancient estate, a reckless act with a cursed Manohra dancers headdress awakens a vengeful spirit that begins to haunt and follow them relentlessly. As paranormal phenomena escalate, they are forced to confront the estates dark secrets in a desperate struggle for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 依成和朋友到聚魂靈山探險,傳說山中埋著千年女屍,千年不滅之陰火,進去的人都逃不出來。淩晨兩點半,依成的朋友先後突然消失。在森林搜索期間,依成進入無限輪回的靈異空間,更恐怖的事情卻接踵而來…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 副警長James奉命看守一具曾舉行神秘儀式的女屍。豈料,他因一時好奇誤觸未完成的邪惡儀式,讓禁忌之門大開,釋放出三個黑暗惡魔。在精神廢墟、幻覺與真實邪祟的瘋狂夾擊下,他的理智逐步瓦解,最終墜入無法逃離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deputy Sheriff James is assigned to guard the body of a woman used in a mysterious ritual. After accidentally completing the unfinished ceremony, he unleashes three dark demons. As psychological torment, terrifying hallucinations and real demonic forces close in, his sanity slowly unravels, plunging him into an inescapable abyss of darkness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬來西亞一座與世隔絕的高原高科技療養院內,Jeghan博士秘密利用三名窮凶極惡的連環殺手進行人體生化改造實驗。豈料實驗失控,三人變異成毫無痛覺、殺戮本能全面覺醒的怪物,血洗實驗室後逃入叢林,恐怖殺戮自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: At a secluded high-tech asylum hidden in the Malaysian highlands, Dr Jeghan secretly conducts biogenetic experiments on three notorious serial killers. When the experiment goes horribly wrong, the mutated killers escape into the jungle as ruthless, pain-free predators, unleashing an unstoppable wave of terror and bloodshed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A docker, Lin Si Hai, accidentally saves Commissioner Cheng who then offers him a position in the police force. Lin is smart and soon rises through the ranks through treachery and corruption, before becoming a gangster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗日戰爭期間,少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦,不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war.  When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled fro

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天,他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢,途中卻遇上革命戰士,並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord’s home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武當派敗類白眉道人、馮道德、雷老虎等,勾結清廷,甘受驅使來殘殺武林中人,方世玉之父母方濟亨、苗翠花,胡惠乾之父皆為雷等所殺;胡一次尋仇不遂,為方所救,後隨方往少林寺練就高強武功...影片最後少林與武當之武林自相殘殺的畫面,出現一幕令人怵目驚心的大結局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次偶然機會下,富家子大用巧遇育幼院院長之外甥女連蓮。二人初次見面,雙方即發生誤會,大用更在匆忙間遺下皮包。當大用硬將連蓮假裝成爲自己的未婚妻好讓兩個傾慕他的女子死心時,又與連蓮發生了第二次誤會...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to ge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述青虹大俠劉文龍的徒弟鬍子峰不耐孤寂生活,非禮殺害村婦後逃走。劉收婦遺孤玉蟬為徒,玉蟬長大後與劉子玉郎相愛,但玉蟬偶遇胡,誤信劉是殺母仇人…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu’s disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名土匪因助俄國抗擊日本而成為北方的大軍閥。由於他好大喜功又目不識丁,老百姓當他是個大笑話。後來,當年曾被他無端殺死的戲班老闆之女出現,槍殺了這個賣國賊。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙,盜去師父的玉龍劍,並生下一子一女;後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭,唐抱子虞江逃走,女青兒則歸師公門下;二十年後,劍再次被盜,青女扮男裝,私下尋劍,卻遇樊舊友天涯客...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master’s Jade Dragon Sword.  She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》,內容描述民國初年,富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙,同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑,更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助,才從大帥手中救回愛人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General’s henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次醉酒後,武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎,因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松,但遭他拒絕。後來,潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染,及後姦情敗露,兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後,先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶,為兄長報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子,遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成,達成了一個賭局,要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力,終戰勝億萬富豪!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three young men offend a billionaire and are drawn into a high stakes bet. If they win, they get to keep the billionaire’s Rolls Royce. Otherwise, they will need to pay the rich man fifty thousand dollars! Will the underdogs win the bet?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會,俏紅娘從中牽赤繩;西廂夜訪,私定終身;崔老夫人知情大怒,憤而拷紅;紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信,終成就百年姻緣。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family’s objection, s

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 郭靖與黃蓉將結拜兄弟楊康之子撫養成人,並取名楊過。黃蓉恐其學武後,替父報仇,為免養虎為患,不許楊過習武。負氣出走的楊過偶遇走火入魔的歐陽鋒,獲授蛤蟆功,更無意中獲悉自己的身世……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father’s death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and enc

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是日本導演上梅次文藝片的經典。故事描述井莉飾的車衣女工與秦沛飾的修車工,在夕陽萌生感情,後女因識破男的太子爺身份,深感受騙...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「叉手」為江湖上新崛起之組織,專殺江湖豪俠,彼等行事,均帶面具,故彼等究為何人,無人知曉。「八臂哪吒」齊山雲會同曾軍及梁勇等,赴景陽鎮調查叉手總壇之所在,擬一舉殲滅該組織,為江湖除害。三人在客棧見一沉默寡言之伙頭,態度極為神秘,暗忖此人必也是來偵查「叉手」者...

epg.episode_synopsis_en: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, whic

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛,得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄,從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品,更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang’s masterpiece and one of the

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃,由當舞女之姊撫養成長,方則出身富家,受母呵護備至。畢業後,凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍,方則滿足於平淡生活中;但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生,改寫了他們三人的一生…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 章臻與月奴相愛卻不被接納,二人被四怪所殺後,留下一對雙胞兒。月奴的姊姊希望挽救其門派的聲望,拆散雙胞,將他們分別送到對立門派收養。十八年後,雙胞胎兒重聚,互相傷殘,亦隨即掀起江湖風風雨雨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nus elder sister hopes to restore the clans honour and separates the twins, arranging for  them to be raised by competing clans. 18 year

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous “Finger of Doom”, a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon la

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鐵中棠是大旗門掌門人雲翼的義子。門派宿敵司徒笑為奪取秘藏,追殺鐵中棠與雲翼次子雲錚。鐵中棠得知,唯有前往長春島尋找武功蓋世的「日后」,才能揭開大旗門的秘密。然而抵達後卻發現「日后」早已身亡,反而遇見大旗門創始人「夜帝」鐵毅,並驚覺對方竟是自己的親生父親。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tie Zhong Tang, adopted son of Da Chi Men leader Yun Yi, is hunted by rival Situ Xiao, who seeks the clans hidden treasure. To uncover its secrets, Tie journeys to Changchun Island to find the legendary Ri Hou. Instead, he finds Ri Hou dead and

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳門古玩店老闆,識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後,威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻;香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人,事後恬要求與石同居,結局出人意表...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Han-hsiang wrote and directed this charming and fascinating comedy, Forbidden Tales Of Two Cities. The two cities in the picture are Macau, where a love quartet is a morally-unsound source for sexual entertainment; and Hong Kong, where a woman ent

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一天,絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走,徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中,阿檬遇上雖貪財,卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下,朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍,但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely dif

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇,二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical Lucky Casino and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 軍閥割據時代,江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮,「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣,反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 水兒原是大太子之私生女,流落青樓 ,二太子欲利用水兒揭大太子醜行以謀皇位。大太子不惜派殺手暗殺水兒,而二太子則命燕十三、練飛霞等護送水兒回宮。兩批人沿途激戰,水兒得武士相救避禍隱居荒村,然二人性格迥異經常引起衝突。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperors daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香,被她所吸引,遂決定隱瞞身份,進入華家作書僮,藉此接近秋香,並向她表明自己的身份和來意,可惜秋香並不相信。最後,唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下,終於抱得美人歸。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 梁觀偕同情侶沈燕,在郊外遊玩談心時,不幸遇上歹徒劫財色,梁護花不成更慘遭毒手。梁之摯友黃國棟報仇心切,遂毅然投身警界,期有機會親自偵緝兇手。五年後,黃因出眾表現被升職之餘,亦與沈日久生情;不久,因一宗離奇的謀殺案件,沈認出當年殺害梁的兇手……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷,滿腹經綸,卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻,夏氏貪圖富貴,強逼如龍退婚;如龍不肯,夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜,將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍,與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京,更以如龍之名赴考,一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡,乃命相國為媒,招為駙馬。洞房之夕,鳳簫向公主
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 余乾文與同門師弟鄭坤元奉師父之命下山尋訪「天地劍」,以免它落入壞人手中造成武林浩劫。余乾文途中巧遇五毒教教主之女蘇皎皎,兩人情投意合。可惜,當蘇皎皎意外地弄傷鄭坤元後,事情也開始變得越來越複雜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon “Thundering Sword” to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quic

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》,被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色,也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh’s looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊俠沈浪與六大門派高手商討對付奸梟歡喜王,正值莊內嚴肅之際,其未婚妻竟無理取鬧,沈只好帶其未婚妻離開。其後,二人繼續追捕歡喜王,但卻意外墮入歡喜王的圈套。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancée suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境,與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局,並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中,她為躲避海關查緝,急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上,卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下,芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀,試圖奪回戒指。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後,馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後,幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Han Emperor dies and his Empress Lu seizes the ruling power. She plots to kill the heir to the throne, Liu Heng, but the masked warrior discovers her plot and tips off Liu. Liu sends his princess to Chang An to ask for help. The masked warrior pr

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計,著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還,被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去,遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還;玉華無奈,只好踏上母親所走過之路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is th

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同,這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法,但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權,因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場,卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Emp

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高,毅然女扮男裝替父從軍,對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰,屢立奇功,更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉,為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候,才得知她是女兒身。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to mar

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天下第一快刀傅紅雪為報父仇,萬里尋兇,途中七名兇手竟逐一離奇暴斃。傅紅雪與好友葉開追查真相,卻發現七人根本未死,一切皆是幕後主使「千面人魔」蕭別離操縱佈局,誘傅墮入圈套。葉開挺身相助,二人卻雙雙身陷刀陣,處境岌岌可危。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟,事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是,當她打算一死以示清白之際,卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意,卻遭遇一連串奇遇,而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院,終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現,改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警,最終成功不讓房東出售家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, defle

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奸相秦權病重,危在旦夕,派手下爭奪長生籐。護衛司馬駿與「九指魔女」沙沙向藥師處取藥被拒,便殺死了藥師。師弟鐵二郎盜走了長生籐,司馬駿追殺鐵二郎,兩人展開了生死決鬥。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls’ high school, is stuck with a baby that isn’t his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女,自此淪落風塵。其後,美麗在酒吧認識占美,深深愛上他,並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候,傷心的美麗即陷入低潮,直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述,胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍,若能奪得,必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館,稱霸江湖...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called Swordswomen Two. Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaws first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for acti

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils t

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In East Texas, the summer after high school, Jack falls in love with Ginny, the daughter of the town's banker (Jack's mom's high school sweetheart). Ginny's been at boarding school; she's headed for Vassar. Over her father's strenuous objections, she spends time with Jack. At summer's end, Jack and Ginny elope to Louisiana (where 17-year-olds can marry without their parents' permission), and he gets a job in the oil fields. Her dad hires a menacing private eye to find them, Ginny's pregnant, her town doctor gives her horrible news, and Jack's mom has her own agenda. It seems that Jack and Ginny have grown up under a liar's moon. What will these sweethearts do?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 徐樂加入警界本想匡扶正義,卻發現整個警界都腐敗不堪。在前輩指點下,他決定力爭上遊,成為最有勢力的探長,改善貪污。此時徐樂的好兄弟伍國豪的黑道勢力日漸壯大,徐樂深知無法勸阻阿豪收手,無奈之下與廉政公署聯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Xu Le joins the police force with a strong desire for justice. Noting the serious corruption in the force, Xu seeks to become the most powerful inspector to eradicate corruption. Though his friend heads a triad gang, Xu still joins forces with the ICAC to provide evidence against the culprits to make them pay the price of their crimes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地球太空基地捕捉到一組來自外太空的神秘訊號,為探尋外星文明,艦長“原帶領船員駕駛著星際探索飛船“深空號駛向宇宙,但不久飛船卻神秘失蹤。150年後,深空號突然出現,船上只剩下一名女科學家“尹。在她..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Captain Yuan and his crew explore the mysteries of outer space after the Space Centre detects extraterrestrial signals. However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖,但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑,但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索,帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城,在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lu and Da are assigned to protect a military officer, but he dies suddenly. As Lu investigates, he finds a dance girl and her brother suspicious, and the brother suddenly goes missing. Lu, Da and the dance girl find themselves involved in a conspiracy and after much investigation, Lu finds the culprit and unravels the secret of a hidden treasure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 江南才子唐伯虎在宴會中為心儀女子桃寶一擲千金,卻被神秘男子出重金羞辱。唐氣憤出手打人,不料那人正是皇上,因此他被通緝。為了躲避追捕,唐偽裝成太監潛入宮中,卻陰差陽錯被卷入閩南王馮達的造反事件。唐得知造..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tang Bo Hu spends lavishly on a woman but is outbid by a mysterious man. Angered, Tang punches the man, who is actually the Emperor. He sneaks into the palace to evade arrest, but gets entangled in a revolt led by King Feng. As Tang discovers that the evidence of Fengs rebellion is hidden in a painting, he vows to uncover the plot.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海上救難隊員阿傑為了生計及克服之前同伴遇難的陰影,再次乘坐漁船出海謀生,卻再次遭遇巨大的危機。在船上的人不僅要面對惡劣的暴雨天氣,還有海底未知生物正對著他們虎視眈眈。在茫茫大海中,猙獰相對的眾人更必須..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navy officer Ah Jie returns to the fleet to earn a living and tries to recover from the trauma of his comrades death. The fleet encounters severe rainstorm and has to face an unknown sea creature. In the face of adversity, everyone on board must overcome the challenges to trust and support each other in order to escape from danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商朝末年,紂王暴虐殘害百姓。與此同時,通天教的仙人們接二連三地因為出手阻撓薑子牙帶領的周軍而喪命。通天教主因此動怒,憤然與申公豹聯手,利用萬仙殺陣企圖一舉清除周軍。薑子牙也結集楊戩、哪吒等眾仙一起對抗..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In late Shang dynasty, the deities of Tong Tian Cult are killed by the Zhou army led by Jiang Zi Ya. Fueled by anger, the Cult leader unites with Shen Gong Pao to exterminate the Zhou army by setting up a thousand deities trap. Meanwhile, Jiang Zi Ya join forces with Yang Jian, Na Zha and other deities to fight the evil forces and rescue mankind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔刀門女弟子雅青初次下山,不慎捲入唐門“蛇人風波,在逃避追殺的途中結識了啞女伏風和江若晨。正當他們陷入絕境時,幸得隱居高人梁玄卿指點知道“蛇人之謎背後隱藏著一個大陰謀。為了尋找真相,三個人齊心協力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Magic Blade Sects disciple Ya Qing gets implicated in a snakeman trouble and meets two girls during her escape from a killer. The three girls are told by a master about the conspiracy behind the snakeman. To uncover the truth, they team up to defeat the mastermind of the conspiracy and unveil the grudges in the elder generation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1925年,平靜的小鎮北海城突然闖入一條巨鱷,不斷有居民被廝殺吞噬。警察隊長鬍彪請了獵戶林七和他的徒弟來抓捕猛獸,林抓住巨鱷後還未鬆口氣卻發現傷人的巨鱷不止一條!在人鱷搏殺,命懸一線之間考驗的不僅是武..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 1925, the peaceful Bei Hai City is terrorized by a giant crocodile that devours and kills villagers. A police inspector assigns Hunter Lin Qi and his disciples to catch the crocodile, but they soon discover that there are more than one. Fighting with the crocodiles becomes a test of physical strength, and the good and evil of human nature.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武林大會時,盟主霍長空與血魔羅決戰時輸了,血魔亦元氣大傷,危急關頭霍將功力注入劉晶體內,劉意外獲得內力。十四年後,劉在隅然機會下來到“霍家拳館,陰差陽錯遇到血魔羅重出江湖找霍家人報仇。有著霍長空功力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated by Blood Demon in a martial arts tournament, Master Huo passes his skills to young Liu Jing. Fourteen years later, Liu chances upon Huos martial arts school and meets Blood Demon who returns for vengeance against Huos clan. Liu fights Blood Demon with Huos legendary skills, upholding justice and protecting Huos clan in a deadly battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時,金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責,默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現,泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘,令他一蹶不振,直到一個男孩的出現,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secret agent Tai accidentally kills his master Ming, as he tries to destroy a powerful criminal gang. Tai is so guilty that he decides to leave the agency, but the gang with Master Ming as its head, reappear years later. Devastated by his masters deception, Tai returns as an agent to settle their grudges after being inspired by a young man.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝嘉靖年間,倭寇入侵、海賊橫行,沿海地區的百姓苦不堪言。青年時期的俞大猷識破倭寇與海賊的詭計,保衛了民眾和大明疆土。而年少時的俞只想做一名大俠,其後在與倭寇及海賊的鬥爭中,他逐漸明白要成為真正的英雄..

After losing his master and comrades, he rises through hardship to defend his nation, avenge his master, and fulfil his heroic destiny.

After losing his master and comrades, he rises through hardship to defend his nation, avenge his master, and fulfil his heroic destiny.

Liu encounters Xiao Luan, a Koi Spirit recincarnated from the Black Dragon, who is also hunted by the demon clan. Can Liu save Xiao Luan and stop the battle?

As Yu gradually falls for Niu, her expelled senior returns and forces Yu to accept his duel challenge by threatening her with Nius safety. A deadly martial arts fight has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Han Miao is one of the eight immortals living in a desert. Dragon Maiden, who helms the East Ocean, loses her memory and becomes a fish demon. When she encounters her destined lover, Han Miao, they quickly fall in love. With help from a guru, they set out for Dragon Gate where Dragon Maiden can resume her identity and locate the water source.

During the mission, they discover a child trapped in a cage but are ambushed on their way to the rescue. As Yu Wei writes the final paragraph of his novel “Ghost Sniper”, he is shot in the head. It is not until he wakes up that Yu Wei realises he has become his novel’s character!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

Through exchanges with rival sect masters and imperial forces, Hong integrates Shaolin martial arts skills into other martial arts styles and established the Hung Sect, which embodied the collective wisdom and beauty of the martial arts world.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a crime-ridden world, there remains a town safeguarded by the private heroes from the triads. Wu Zheng Yi practises kung fu everyday and finally becomes a private hero with the help from Xiong. When Wu discovers that the private heroes are controlled by the evil gang, he teams up with his master Xiong to vanquish the evil gang boss.

The White Haired Witch is entangled in a conspiracy amidst the battle of the martial arts world. As Imperial guard Chang An investigates on her, he falls for the White Haired Witch. Finally, Chang An uncovers the true leader of the Demon Cult, thus clearing her name.

Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: To stop the Japanese pirates and find his missing friend, the Ming dynasty Marine Officer Lin Xiao joins the Marine General to embark on a treasure hunt. On the way, they encounter a mysterious sea monster as well as the pirates. Lin must join forces with the marine team to battle against them and accomplish their mission.

A new imperial scholar wants to investigate the well but is imprisoned for allegedly offending the Dragon Emperor. Xiao Yuan seeks help from Song Ci to rescue the scholar and unravels the truth behind Ling Long Towns mystery.

They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

Meanwhile, the snake clans descendant and two animal protection experts venture to the island to confirm the existence of the legendary Titan Snake, resulting in a fierce battle with the ruthless gang to preserve the islands ecology.
