epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,津沽城命案接連發生,警局束手無策。一向以風水破案的段宇豪和祁威被要求調查此案以戴罪立功,免除之前的懲罰,但在找線索的同時,二人卻被一步步地推向多年前發生的羅剎鳥連環殺人案。段宇豪與祁..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In crime-ridden Jin Gu City, the police are unable to solve the murder cases. Duan Yu Hao and Qi Wei are assigned to investigate the cases through fortune-telling. In the process, a murder case that happened years ago is brought to their attention, and they vow to uncover the truth and find the murderer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明德市郊外發生了一宗拋屍命案,公安局副局長楊棟帶領整個警隊展開深入調查。他們逐步揭開了以企業家林峰為首的頂峰集團涉嫌殺人、放高利貸、及開設賭場等罪行。隨著對掃除黑勢力專案的持續進行,那些無惡不作的犯罪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A police deputy chief leads an investigation about a body discovered in Ming De Town, and gradually unveils a series of crimes, including murder, loan sharking and casino activities by a company owned by entrepreneur Lin Feng. The police go all out to fight vigorously against the criminals as anti-triad operations continue...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 元朝末年,一個名為修羅幕主的神秘組織聲稱擁有武林至寶八極玄盒。他們邀請了頂尖的武林高手參加武林大會,事實上想用秘製毒藥控制他們為組織效力。太極宗師張三豐為要揭露組織的陰謀參加了武林大會,最終解開了八極..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the late Yuan dynasty, a secret gang invites top martial arts masters to an event to showcase a martial arts treasure, with an intention to drug the masters so that they fall under their control and can serve the gang. Tai Chi master Zhang San Feng attends the event to uncover their plot and successfully destroys the evil gang in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生,有志之士誓要推翻蘅王,立下衣帶詔。蘅王請魏侯爺找出衣帶詔,並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上,而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕,與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Under the oppressive rule of Emperor Heng, some volunteers sign on the Belt Oath to overthrow the government. The Emperor sends killers to eliminate them, including Bai Shan Sui and Xie Rou. Xies brother falls for Bai, so he follows the killers to the inn, but ends up causing a series of hilarious events due to misunderstandings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白,兩人墜入愛河之際,病毒突然在學校中爆發,柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯,鄭問找到教..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huo, a famous university botany professor, uses animal and plant DNAs to develop a virus. His assistant, Cheng, falls in love with his student, Ke, but Ke gets infected during a sudden virus outbreak in the university. To save Ke and the university, Cheng stumbles upon the professors secret laboratory and unveils a secret between Huo and Ke.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 唐時期垂拱元年,武則天率領百官坐龍船夜巡運河,各人奔向龍門只為一睹天后聖容,沒想到卻在運河之中遭遇龍形異獸衝撞龍船,引起了百姓的議論,認為是不祥之兆。武則天對此事件勃然大怒,召見狄仁傑前去調查運河龍王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Empress Wu and her officials patrol the Grand Canal one night. As the crowd rushes to see her in person, a dragon monster appears and hits on the vessel. This is believed to be an ominous sign. Empress Wu is angry and asks Detective Di to investigate the case. Detective Di uses his investigative mind to unravel the truth and find the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 未來世界,人工智慧高速發展,由程非掌控的地下科研組織,為牟取暴利研製激發異能人的晶片。由於一次變故,程下令清除所有實驗者,導致千鶴母親犧牲,而逃出生天的千鶴為替母親報仇,以身涉險對抗惡勢力,在危急關頭..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In an AI-driven world, the underground institute has developed chips which can activate supernatural power for profiteering. An accident occurs and killed Qian Hes mother. Qian He vows to avenge her mothers death and fight against the villains after provoking her supernatural power, finally unveiling the institutes hidden secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生,終獲高人指點,學成歸家,之後卻把師父“不可生邪念的教誨丟在腦後,學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎,又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟,決定用屬於自己的方式來..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Wang Sheng aspires to learn Laoshan Taoism skills. Under the tutelage of his master, Wang acquires the skills but succumbs to greed, forsaking the masters teachings of Think No Evil. As Wang finds out about his own identity, his epiphany sparks enlightenment, prompting him to forge his unique path in vanquishing the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊防部隊正在追蹤國內最大毒梟組織旭東商會的一批價值數百萬美元的毒品,卻被劉老三團夥搶走。警方找到在監獄服刑劉的兄弟大飛,說服他幫忙找回毒品。組織老大黃旭東知道貨被搶,便找了國際僱傭軍準備捉人搶貨。邊防..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Recruited from prison for an undercover mission, convict Da Fei returns to the criminal underworld to investigate his former sworn brother, who stole a cartel drug shipment. However, when ruthless mercenaries kidnap his mother, Da Fei joins forces with border police in a desperate battle for justice and redemption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 邊境小鎮妖魔遺禍,吳靖子發出請柬,請各位降妖高手前來支援。市井遊民阿拾,意外被孟珠救下後竟愛上孟珠,要拜她為師,一路跟著孟珠及其他降妖高手前往小鎮去消滅在雲棧洞內的千年豬妖。最後阿拾以自己的性命為代價..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wu Jing Zi seeks help from demon hunters to cast away the evil spirits in town. Saved by demon hunter Meng Zhu, Ah Shi falls in love with her and becomes her disciple. They journey to Yu Zhan Cave to kill the Pig Demon with other hunters. In the end, Ah Shi sacrifices himself to let the hunters fight their way out, but the result is unexpected...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多年前九龍黑幫頭目章山河因與人火拼而入獄,此時妻子亦因難產而亡,留下女兒。章出獄後,決定放棄黑幫舊業,獨自撫養女兒。然而章為救昔日兄弟,卻導致黑幫老大塔里意外身亡,因此引來塔的弟弟查儂報復,殺死了他的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Zhang was jailed when his wife died after giving birth to their daughter. When Zhang is released, he decides to quit the triad and take care of his daughter but accidentally kills the triad boss. Ta Lis brother, Cha, takes revenge by kidnapping Zhangs daughter, resulting in a deadly battle between the two men.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年後的未來世界,一群食客打算去一家違法經營的野味飯店享受一頓野味大餐,突然當中有一隻變種巨蜥衝破了鐵籠逃走,之後店員一個接一個地神秘失蹤。在此同時捕鼠專家阿發接到飯店的滅鼠委託,本來的滅鼠行動卻變..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2040s, a group of customers visits an illegal restaurant serving wild animal meat. Suddenly, a giant lizard mutant escapes from the cage and the restaurant staff disappears one by one. Meanwhile, a rat catcher is tasked by the restaurant to exterminate rats, but it turns out to be a terrifying battle against the lizard.

epg.programme_title_tc: 伏妖開封府之御貓展昭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北宋時期,宦官專權,邪靈橫行,汴梁境內興起了許多邪教,其中最大勢力是“外九流。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案,然而“外九流的人試圖毒害包拯,還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況,開封府眾人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前海外某安保公司的精英隊員韓彬,在一次保護任務時失敗,從此銷聲匿跡,頹廢終日。老拍檔希望韓能重新振作,在他極力邀請下,韓答應保護明星蘇曉琪前往東南亞某國拍攝節目。一路上,韓化解了多次威脅曉琪生命安全的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Former elite security guard Han Bin vanishes after a failed escort mission and wallows in self pity. His partner encourages Han to be his former self by escorting an actress to Southeast Asia to film a show. On the way, Han successfully deals with threats to the actress life, but realizes in the end that he is the one the evil gang has targeted!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張宸是軍事戰術教官,經常輾轉於世界各地為安保公司做戰術培訓。一次意外中,張被捲入一宗謀殺案,成了當地的通緝犯。張被迫逃亡,並在同伴初五的幫助下找到了謀殺案倖存者黛米。三人相互配合,開始著手調查,在槍林..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Military instructor Zhang Zhen accidentally gets involved in a murder and becomes the suspect. He is forced to flee and with the help of his companion, Zhang finds the sole survivor of the murder. The trio launches an investigation and strives to uncover the truth, which seems to be connected to a human smuggling gang and a military organization.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 弟弟杜家豪在上水鎮被水猴子殘殺,民國女法醫清伶為了探尋真相便前往上水鎮探尋原因。在這詭異的村莊,關於水猴子復仇的“詛咒接二連三發生。清伶携槍勇闖水怪禁地黑木林,而她力憑科學文明剷除水猴子的封建迷信,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Forensic pathologist Qing investigates her brothers murder by the water monkeys in a town where the curse of a vengeful monkey ensues. Armed with a gun, Qing ventures to the forbidden land of Water Monster and debunks superstitions with scientific facts, ultimately leading the villagers to fight against the evil forces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥,人族首領黃帝得奇門遁甲的力量終於平定世界,之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭周同因為被死對頭追殺,逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了周同,及後在霧..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the battle between human and demons, human race leader, Huang Di, restores peace by magical astronomy and establishes the Wu Yin Sect. During an  escape, Detective Zhou encounters the dying Wu Yin Sect boss, who passes on his martial arts skills to Zhou. With the help of the sect, Zhou finds his inner power to defeat the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在東北下鄉的知識青年胡八一等人為了救助患病的村民畫眉,聯合獵人趙叔前去森林雪人熊洞採集解藥。然而,一夥人突然遭到熊的攻擊,只好逃入黃鼠狼地下洞穴。他們目睹了那裡發生的奇怪事情和出現幻覺。胡等人破除迷信..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Scholar Hu Ba and hunter Zhao venture to a bear-guarded cave to find an antidote to cure a sick villager. Attacked by the bear, they take refuge in a weasels cave where they encounter bizarre incidents and illusions. After Hu and Zhao dispelled the superstition trap and uncovered the true culprit, they successfully escape and rescue the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,觀山太保傳人封四九為了幫助籌募軍餉,答應鄭大帥嫡子鄭東西請求,尋找死在千季古地宮“九館裡的遺體。鄭其實想找尋寶物,同時又找了發丘中郎一族後代陳青山一同參與。眾人幾番陷入兇險,幸好陳與封互相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To raise funds for their troops, Master Feng agress to help Zheng Dong Xi find corpses within an ancient tomb. Zhengs true motive is to uncover the tombs hidden treasure and he also enlist the help of Chen. Together, they embark on a perilous expedition to hunt for the treasure as well as to help the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在地球未來,人類大量排放廢氣製造垃圾,使到地球迎來沙化期。動植物變異產生地球新主人“沙蟲,而它們將人類逼到滅絕邊緣,倖存者只能尋找僅存的避難所“綠洲。一支由富商、科學家、保安隊長、機械師以及混混組..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In future earth, humans emit exhaust gas to produce waste, leading to earths desertification. Desert Bugs are mutated to cause human extinction and the last hope of the survivors is to find the oasis. A team made up of tycoons, scientists, security chiefs, engineers and gangsters embarks on a perilous journey in an armoured tank to find the oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世,將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄,少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海,不畏困難,幫助慧海破除心魔,參透少林精神,最終憑..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a battle between Buddha and Devil, Shaolin disciple Hui Hai embarks on a journey to find Luo Han to stop the demon from turning the world upside down. Accompanied by his childhood friend, Hui is fearless and masters the Shaolin spirit. Eventually with the Shaolin skills, they banish all demons and restore peace to the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上陽郡主王萱在與寒族將軍蕭霽新婚之夜,為遵守與愛人三皇子子珩的約定,甘願飲毒酒假死,豈料這一切只是皇權氏族的陰謀算計。王萱傷透了心,為了報仇化身為吸食人血的修羅女,連子珩對她也非常懼怕。然而蕭霽卻對王..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Princess Wang fakes death on her wedding day with General Xiao to fulfil her vow with her secret lover. After realizing it was a set up by the Emperor, Wang is devastated and turns into a blood demon to take revenge. However, General Xiao still stands by her side and helps her to uncover the truth behind an even bigger conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十世紀90年代末的哈爾濱,于鐵在替人收債時,對借貸人的女兒金佳麗一見鍾情。鐵雖然是收債人,但他為人講義氣、心地善良及認真對待感情的態度,終於打動了麗。可惜鐵突如其來的頭痛,加上與收債組織的大哥在處事..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the late 90s in Harbin, Tie falls for Li while collecting debts from her father. Li is touched by Ties loyalty, kindness and desire for true love. Unfortunately, a sudden headache hits Tie and he gets into an argument with the boss of the debt collection agency, putting more strain on the relationship of the two lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百里無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓,但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事,說她是被西廠迫害,而百里才是出賣義士的走狗!事情越來越可疑,何不一定是走狗,而百里也可能不是大俠..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young blacksmith Lui encounters his idol, Swordsman Bai Li, and helps Bai deport He Qing Ying, a lackey of the emperors secret agency. However, He claims that she is innocent while Bai Li is the one who has betrayed the patriots. Things become suspicious and Lui is unsure of whom to trust. Who will he trust in the end?

Inside the tomb, they encounter various difficulties and experience life and death. In the process, they also discover a mysterious treasure in the tomb and unveils their masters secret.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gao, an ambulance driver, aspires to be a car racer. He meets top race car engineer Bao during a car racing dispute, which sets him on a path towards his dream. Gao faces the dilemma of leading a stable life or pursuing his passion, but finally decides to embrace his dream and live life to the fullest with the support of his close friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Robin assists a police officer to investigate a serial murder. While they discover that most victims are incognito illusionists, Robin thinks that the murderer kills for a treasure, and later identifies Mei as the culprit who uses dark illusions to kill. Mei summons White Tiger to fight against the Fire Dragon commanded by Robin.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗倭寇志士追馬流落到邊境沙漠之地,選擇在這裡開一家客棧來度過餘生。一天,仇人之女白鹿攜寶箱逃命到客棧,追馬本可有機會把她除掉,然而白鹿要將寶箱中可以對抗倭寇的機密平安送出。追馬為了民族大義,最終放棄仇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seeking a tranquil existence, anti-Japanese patriot Zhui operates an inn on the outskirts of town. The daughter of his foe flees to his inn one day with a treasure box containing the secret to fight the Japanese bandits. Though Zhui can easily kill her, he sets aside his hatred aside to help Bai fight back and deliver the secret box safely.

The Monster Kings real purpose is to suck peoples blood and control the world through eudemon. Knowing his evil plan, Constable Xie decides to unlock his hidden power and begins a fierce battle with Monster King.

He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

He finds the cases key person, demolishes a secret base with his best friend Liu, and kills the Fire Dragon, vowing to uncover the truth.

Ya Mei sneaks in and helps her teammates to escape by setting off a bomb, at the same time faking the death of herself and her fiancée. Three years later, Mei must resume duty to fight against Ba Song in order to save her kidnapped fiancée.

Three years later, Zhang infiltrates a drug lab in an investigation, only to discover that it is operated by his former teammate Hu. When a drug gang raids the lab, Zhang is trapped in the fierce battle.

When Huo escorts a revolutionary leader to the capital, he finally understands that the country and its people are the ultimate purpose for practising martial arts.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, demon catcher Guan meets Ye Fei, a gambler who always loses, when he fights against the fox demon. Guan meets the troubled Ye Fei again after he resolves a case involving innocent deaths in a brothel, and they team up to successfully fight against the demons and evil spirits with their wit and bravery.

Upon investigation, Guo discovers a man named Xia Chong disguising himself as the female ghost, leading to the revelation of a peculiar murder case.

With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

However, the spacecraft vanishes after lift-off. 150 years later, the spacecraft reappears, harbouring a female scientist. The secret of outer space is unveiled through her recollection of the crew’s peculiar experience.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漫畫展上,宅男漫畫家郝萍穹意外與殺手肖白菜交換了身體。穹由廢柴變成擁有豐滿身材和超能力的少女,但他卻不斷被壞人追殺。白菜不用擔心受敵人襲擊,但她卻每天過著被追稿的生活。這換位人生讓他們更了解自己的能力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bottom-ranking cartoonist Hao and killer Xiao accidentally swapped identities at a comic fair. Hao becomes a powerful girl but is pursued by villains, while Xiao is free from pursuit but must work on deadlines everyday. After knowing their capabilites and responsibilities, they resume their identities and team up to fight the villains.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 神州名將李追風在北坡城被薩滿十萬大軍包圍。為了救出李和一眾將士,黃自在將軍組織了八百人隊伍前往營救,在經過重重險阻後終於救出李將軍,並且為了拖延薩滿士兵而甘願留下來鎮守北坡城,等待李將軍帶援軍趕來。最..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Huang leads 800 warriors to rescue General Li and other generals trapped by the 100,000 Sha Men troops in Bai Po City. He successfully saved General Li after overcoming various dangers, and stalled Sha Men forces as they await troop reinforcements.  In the end, General Li and the 800 warriors heroically safeguard their homeland.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期,用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立,以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及征戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞,三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

epg.programme_title_tc: 伏妖開封府之御貓展昭
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北宋時期,宦官專權,邪靈橫行,汴梁境內興起了許多邪教,其中最大勢力是“外九流。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案,然而“外九流的人試圖毒害包拯,還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況,開封府眾人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Eunuchs are powerful in the Northern Song Dynasty as evil religion sects emerge, with the largest one being “Wai Jiu Liu”. As Justice Bao, Zhan Zhao and Gong Sun Ce secretly preside over the trials involving evil spirits, the disciples of “Wai Jiu Liu” try to poison Bao and hedge a huge plot. How can Justice Bao tackle the plight?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期,志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命,帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻,孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡,孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定,要困死那個..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meng, a Volunteer Army platoon leader, is commissioned to rescue a platoon in captive. Through arduous trials, Meng teams up with another platoon leader, Du. They decide to contain the enemys artillery supply to reduce casualties, and vow to dedicate themselves to fight against the foes for their people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上古時期,魔族首領蚩尤擾亂天庭,最終被打回原形,天尊把他貶為凡人,及賜給他仁慈的心。數年後,蚩尤體內的魔性被別有用心的人喚醒,他便前往昆侖尋求解封方法。蚩尤途中結識了火焰山公主葉瀟瀟,二人情愫漸生,而..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in ancient times, leader of the demon tribe, Chi You, causes chaos in heaven and is demoted to become a kind human. When Chi Yous evil power awakens years later, he find ways to break his seal in Kun Lun, where he meets a princess and fall in love. Through perilous trials, Chi You and the princess unravel the truth behind a conspiracy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退休運動員肖力在父親的激勵下,帶領村中的女童足球隊贏得了比賽,並且幫助學校擺脫了困境。這勵志的故事展現了人們為了美好生活奮鬥,在過程中增進及修補了家人、戀人、師生等人與人之間的相互關係,並表達了美好生..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Motivated by his father, a retired athlete helps the female soccer team to win the game and ease the plight of the school. This inspirational story showcases the effort by people to achieve a better life while working hard at relationships with family members, lovers, teachers and students.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 北魏年間,新君登基,時局未穩,遊牧民族柔然對魏國虎視眈眈。為牽制柔然,大魏公主和親北涼,不料卻被柔然猛將綿爾圖擄走。綿挾持公主,要魏國在兩日內交出十座城池為贖金。魏國將軍花木蘭臨危受命,更啟用死囚慕容..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Northern Wei empire faces raids from the nomadic Rou Ran tribe. The princess of Wei is kidnapped by a Rou Ran general, who demands ten cities as ransom. Weis General Mulan forms a special task force to rescue the princess and a fatal battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲,以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己,可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇,而少男亦替少北贏回..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shao Nan is proud of his brother Shao Bai being the combat fighting champion. When Shao Bei died after being seriously injured in a fight, the founder of the fight company decides to train Shao Nan for vengeance. Shao Nan eventually rises to become the next champion, fulfilling his brothers last wish and make Asians proud.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A self-declared ghost buster Hao, and his two disciples, possess good skills but resort to fraud ghost hunting skills to make money. When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公即將在突破最後一層成為降龍羅漢的關鍵時刻,感應到白水鎮村民有難,於是他放棄修行前往白水鎮解救百姓。在這裡他遇到了假扮濟公的黃元蠱惑百姓,差點把濟公燒死,但最終黃元被濟公所感化,並幫助濟公一起降魔伏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ji Gong is about to transform into the Arhat when he foresees a threat to the villagers in town and decides to sacrifice his practice to rescue them. He encounters Huang, who impersonates him and bewitches the villagers, leading Ji Gong to be nearly burnt alive. When Huang is finally enlightened by Ji Gong, he joins him to subdue the demons.

epg.programme_title_en: Seventeen and a Half Years Old
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 張君佳是一名高中學生,為了接近校花黃巧姍,他想拍一部微電影,讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來,他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片,拍攝期間,眾人幾經波折,劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhang Jun Jia directs a micro movie starring the school girl he likes. As Arts festival approaches, Zhang and his classmates decide to make a college zombie movie. They encounter many difficulties in the process and despite the production team falling into pieces, they manage to overcome the challenges with love amongst friends, family and lovers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國,加入了殺手組織都司府,成為十二暗軍的預備役,專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技,在查案時邂逅秋葵,兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死,最終葛..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his country, Ge Zhen joins a killer squad assigned for secret government missions. It is when Ge Zhen investigates a case that he encounters Qiu Kui and they fall in love. At the same time, Wu Ma, the most powerful killer in the squad is mysteriously murdered. Can Ge Zhen and Qiu Kui be together, and can Ge Zhen rescue his country?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期,北海神探張一人奉命到太平鎮調查一樁離奇兇案。村民們都傳是女鬼冤魂作祟,張在調查的過程中也接二連三有人遇害,跟著紙人勾魂、怨靈作祟的說法也悄然傳開。最終,張在當地乞丐狗子協助下把兇手繩之以法。..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Zhang investigates a peculiar murder case in Taiping Town where villagers believe a female ghost is responsible. As Zhang investigates, more murders occur, sparking rumours of paper demons and vengeful wraiths. With the help of Beggar Gou Zi, Zhang finds the culprit and unveils the secret behind the serial murders.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英的閆鵬在追捕毒販赤那時,同事兼好友阿古拉犧牲於毒販手中。之後鵬來到阿古拉家照顧他的家人,卻不料碰上真正的赤那到來,要阿古拉父親帶路,幫他逃離邊境。鵬隨後才知道,先前被他消滅的毒販竟然是赤那的孿..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agula, a friend and coworker of Narcotic agent Yan, is killed by the drug dealer Chi Na. While Yan takes care of Agulas family, he encounters Chi Na who wants to flee the country with the help of Agulas father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋遼太平時期,原本是秘密組織“鳳火軍培養的特工唐紫煙被安插在京都皇城司任職。正當唐紫煙想悄悄退出,與丈夫過上平靜的餘生時,丈夫卻被鳳凰火軍帶走來威脅唐接受新任務,刺殺來訪的北朝特使皇太弟。唐決心脫離..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Tang is trained by the secret society to work undercover in the imperial government. Tang wants to quit for a peaceful life with her husband but is forced to kill the Imperial Prince when the society holds her husband hostage. Tang resolves to break free and joins forces with the Imperial Prince to destroy the society and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清乾隆年間,紅花會老舵主于萬亭病逝,命其義子陳家洛受命接任掌門之位。之後紅花會多個分舵遭受襲擊,而四當家文泰來下落不明。陳與消息靈通的玉如意達成交易,兩人與幾位當家合作營救文。其後陳發現文的失蹤可能是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Qing dynasty, Chen Jia Luo is appointed as the new leader of Red Flower Society. Thereafter, the societys members face attacks and one of their branch leaders, Wen, goes missing. As Chen teams up with Yu to rescue Wen, he uncovers a connection between Wen’s disappearance and King Fus treasure. Meanwhile, Yus real identity also surfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 城裡驚現“僵屍病毒,人心惶惶,民不聊生。茅山弟子雲淩與三位師兄弟奉命下山盡辦法解救百姓於水火,不料四人卻步入幕後黑手的陷阱,被幻蠱術迷惑,挑撥四人之間的兄弟情。及後城中更有一只壯如怪獸的食人鬼蛛入侵..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a town ravaged by the vampire virus, four Maoshan disciples including Yun Ling are tasked with finding the cure. However, they are entrapped by the schemes of the mastermind, which caused discord amongst them. When the town is besieged by a spider demon, the four disciples have to overcome their conflicts and unite to save the people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武周時期,生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青,另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件,二人組成了臨時搭檔..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Zhou dynasty, two girls living in two ends of the Luo He River come from diverse backgrounds - one is a captains daughter and another is a common swindler - and they encounter a series of mysterious events in Luo Yang City. Both team up to investigate a series of bizarre cases, to uphold justice and to maintain order amidst a social upheaval.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東漢末年亂世紛爭,少年趙子龍與同鄉夏侯蘭因為一場意外而捲入到這個亂世中來,但他們二人卻選擇了不同的人生道路。最終趙子龍戰勝了為一己之私而背叛初衷的夏侯蘭。趙持長劍於亂世行走,踏破黑暗掀起波瀾,最終選擇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Eastern Han Dynasty, young Zhao Zi Long and his comrade Xia Hou Lan accidentally get involved in the chaos, but they end up with different paths in life. Zhao Zi Long finally triumphs over the selfish Xia Hou Lan and fights against the dark forces, teaming up with Liu Bei and achieving victories for the Han dynasty in the end.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜,在天水村遇到離奇事件,傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊,現在怨靈回魂伺機索命,流言四起。在調查期間,閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場,不被封建迷信所蒙蔽,努力探尋真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rumour has it that a water monster destroyed the village 20 years ago, and now its vengeful spirit has returned. As Yan and his master encounter mysterious incidents in the village, Yan decides to find out the truth without being influenced by superstitions. In the process, Yan discovers his true identity and captures the real culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新娘元如意在洞房花燭夜全家被殺,自己被一蒙面人救出。一年後,如意在消息販子包大庭口中得知,父親為救百姓當年殺死了一個賊寇,賊寇之子鐵背駝爺為報父仇血洗元家。在包的幫助下,如意尋找敵人的弱點,一個個剷除..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A bride named Ru is the sole survivor of her familys massacre, and is rescued by a masked man. A year later, she learns from the newsmonger Bao that the massacre was orchestrated by a bandit who wants to avenges his fathers death caused by Rus father. With the help of Bao, Ru vanquishes the lackeys of the bandit and seeks her own vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國時期上海,怪物獵人宇文預測到上豪大飯店有怪獸出現,而當怪獸現身襲擊表演的花旦顧青時,宇文英雄救美,打斷富少警探天明的公開表白。之後三人被捲入了一系列的奇怪案件,在調查過程中,所有線索都指向一個塵封..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican time in Shanghai, monster hunter Yu saves an actress in a play from a monsters attack, at the same time interrupting a cops love confession for her. As the trio gets involved in a series of mysterious cases, they find out that the cases are related to a legend about a giant monster who will soon be returning to the world...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英陳泰樺、老米、阿峰與阿棠奉命秘密緝捕跨國毒梟,卻因隊內黑警洩密,行動甫展開便落入圈套。阿峰當場殉職,隊長盧Sir壯烈犧牲,阿棠則神秘失蹤,兄弟情誼自此崩離。多年後,倖存的陳泰樺與老米誓要查明真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a corrupt cop leaks their operation, four elite narcotics officers are ambushed while pursuing a cross-border drug lord. One is killed, their leader dies in the line of duty, and another vanishes without a trace. Years later, the surviving Chan Tai Wah and Low Mai reunite to expose the long-hidden mole and avenge their fallen comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工阿文被安排潛伏於東南亞的軍火商旗下,尋找其手中的一批軍火炸藥並將其銷毀。當他終於找到該批軍火後,卻遭到不明匪徒襲擊。為防止災難發生,阿文決定與他的特工搭檔阿瓊合力奪回軍火。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two homicide detectives investigate a series of grisly murders deep in the forest, where disturbing evidence points to the legendary “Beast”. As the body count rises, they uncover a chilling link between the killings and an ancient local legend, while a terrifying truth hidden deep within the woods slowly comes to light.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年鍾馗因家鄉慘遭妖族血洗,痛失至親摯愛。背負血海深仇的他決心下山追凶,卻意外邂逅異變成半妖的刁蠻公主,更揭開昔日戀人詭異「復活」背後的跨界奪權陰謀。面對群妖禍害蒼生,鍾馗手持鎮魔聖劍,一路斬妖除魔,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After demons massacre his hometown and kill his loved ones, young Zhong Kui sets out for revenge. Along the way, he meets a half-demon princess and uncovers a sinister plot behind his former lovers mysterious resurrection. Wielding the Sacred Demon-Slaying Sword, he battles evil and becomes the legendary Demon Queller Zhong Kui.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒精英陳泰樺、老米、阿峰與阿棠奉命秘密緝捕跨國毒梟,卻因隊內黑警洩密,行動甫展開便落入圈套。阿峰當場殉職,隊長盧Sir壯烈犧牲,阿棠則神秘失蹤,兄弟情誼自此崩離。多年後,倖存的陳泰樺與老米誓要查明真..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a corrupt cop leaks their operation, four elite narcotics officers are ambushed while pursuing a cross-border drug lord. One is killed, their leader dies in the line of duty, and another vanishes without a trace. Years later, the surviving Chan Tai Wah and Low Mai reunite to expose the long-hidden mole and avenge their fallen comrades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 特工阿文被安排潛伏於東南亞的軍火商旗下,尋找其手中的一批軍火炸藥並將其銷毀。當他終於找到該批軍火後,卻遭到不明匪徒襲擊。為防止災難發生,阿文決定與他的特工搭檔阿瓊合力奪回軍火。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩名兇殺組探員深入密林調查一連串離奇命案,現場遺留的線索竟與流傳已久的「野獸」傳說不謀而合。隨著死亡人數不斷攀升,他們發現這些兇案竟與當地流傳已久的古老傳說有著詭異的關聯,一場潛伏於密林深處的恐怖真相..

epg.programme_title_tc: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
epg.programme_title_en: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybri
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Gabriella的家人慘死於混血怪物之手。為了復仇,她投身血獵手的行列,毅然踏上獵殺之途。與同伴並肩,向冷血的地下軍權組織宣戰—一場腥風血雨的亡命激鬥就此展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

epg.programme_title_en: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,邪惡的黑羽會潛入了老邪神西城勇的地盤,盜走了修羅面具,而利用修羅面具放出當時只是個嬰兒的魔神。老邪神為了魔神日後不作惡收養了嬰兒,教他好好做人,成為小邪神。小邪神最後控制了面具的力量成為老邪..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天才拳擊手徐佳陽為了替父親還賭債在地下酒館打黑拳時被舉報,痛失奧運資格賽,隕落拳壇。十年後,鐵血教練陳麗月決要助她實現父親的遺願,重回拳壇找回昔日的自己。當拳擊的熱血碰上責任時,曾經失落的拳擊夢能否再..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.programme_title_tc: Live and Die in East LA
epg.programme_title_en: Live and Die in East LA
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東州地區長期盤踞一支販毒集團。霹靂女子突擊隊隊員梅靜率領其他隊員成功攻入販毒集團的制毒基地,卻中了預先設下的埋伏,梅爸爸是犯罪集團內部的臥底身份亦隨之暴露。最後,梅靜與突擊隊員們經歷一輪激戰後,擊敗對..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 法蘭克與女友到中東旅行時,女友慘遭殺害,他更被誣陷為兇手入獄。在死牢中結識一名獄友,並在對方暗中協助下策劃越獄,誓要揭開真相,將真正的兇手繩之以法。然而,唯一的盟友卻在行動前夕離奇身亡,法蘭克唯有孤注..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed during a tragic trip to the Middle East. Imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, he befriends a fellow inmate who helps him plot a daring escape to prove his innocence. However, when his only ally suddenly dies, Frank must risk everything to escape and uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女警梅根與幾名好友到叢林露營度假,卻意外撞破當地腐敗警長非法處決毒販的血腥黑幕。驚覺罪行敗露的警長隨即懸賞萬元,聯合民兵封鎖整座大山展開血腥圍獵。身陷叢林深處、走投無路的梅根唯有帶領同伴深入虎穴,迎戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While camping in the woods with friends, police officer Megan witnesses a corrupt sheriff executing drug dealers in cold blood. When the sheriff puts a bounty on her head and mobilizes local militia to hunt her down, Megan and her companions must fight through the wilderness and risk everything to escape alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Frank is framed for murder after his girlfriend is killed during a tragic trip to the Middle East. Imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, he befriends a fellow inmate who helps him plot a daring escape to prove his innocence. However, when his only ally suddenly dies, Frank must risk everything to escape and uncover the truth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女警梅根與幾名好友到叢林露營度假,卻意外撞破當地腐敗警長非法處決毒販的血腥黑幕。驚覺罪行敗露的警長隨即懸賞萬元,聯合民兵封鎖整座大山展開血腥圍獵。身陷叢林深處、走投無路的梅根唯有帶領同伴深入虎穴,迎戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: While camping in the woods with friends, police officer Megan witnesses a corrupt sheriff executing drug dealers in cold blood. When the sheriff puts a bounty on her head and mobilizes local militia to hunt her down, Megan and her companions must fight through the wilderness and risk everything to escape alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一場發生在三國動盪時期的史詩式之旅。曹操試圖招攬關羽加入他的陣營,但關羽忠於他的結拜兄弟劉備,也是曹操的敵人。當關羽試圖從曹操手上救出劉備的小妾時,迫於無奈要大開殺戒。最後他能否殺出重圍?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

epg.programme_title_tc: Live and Die in East LA
epg.programme_title_en: Live and Die in East LA
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 急診醫生Attila救治一名車禍男童後,意外捲入洛杉磯東區的黑道糾紛。男童竟是黑幫頭目的兒子,而車禍則是預謀的幫派復仇。為救涉案的妹妹免於牢獄之災,Attila被迫成為黑幫的運毒棋子,由此引發一場血腥..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東州地區長期盤踞一支販毒集團。霹靂女子突擊隊隊員梅靜率領其他隊員成功攻入販毒集團的制毒基地,卻中了預先設下的埋伏,梅爸爸是犯罪集團內部的臥底身份亦隨之暴露。最後,梅靜與突擊隊員們經歷一輪激戰後,擊敗對..

epg.programme_title_tc: 混世四猴: 神猴歸來
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 救世主靈明石猴曾賜予絕望女孩生存的希望,並許下守護終生的承諾。不料多年後,他與傲慢的三眼戰神展開一場毀天滅地的大戰,最終慘遭擊敗,金身碎裂墮入凡塵。失去神力的石猴,究竟能否重燃鬥志,打破命運枷鎖,再度..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The legendary Stone Monkey gives hope to a desperate girl by promising to change her fate. Years later, after a fierce battle against the powerful three-eyed God of War, he is defeated and cast into the mortal world. Stripped of his former glory, Stone Monkey must rise again, confront powerful enemies, and fulfil the promise he once made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 商人Burks被一對走投無路的夫婦綁架,被迫踏上開往洛杉磯的亡命之旅。途中危機四伏,三人發現彼此隱藏著致命的秘密。一場原本以為簡單的綁架,卻演變成奪命的博弈,當中沒有人能按計劃全身而退!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kidnapped by a desperate couple, businessman Burks Hill is forced on a frantic journey to Los Angeles. As danger mounts, the three travellers discover that they each harbour deadly secrets. What began as a simple kidnapping spirals into a lethal game where no ones plan will survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Detective Dee: The Ghosts in Weird Town
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狄仁傑調查幽冥鎮接連發生的離奇僵屍變異事件,意外揭露幕後黑手竟是圖謀叛亂的越王李貞。面對亡靈肆虐與重重陰謀,狄仁傑憑藉機智與膽識力挫邪惡勢力,揭露了李貞的叛亂計畫。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Dee investigates a series of terrifying vampire transformations in Youming Town, uncovering a sinister conspiracy masterminded by Prince Li Zhen, who plots to overthrow the empire. Armed with courage and ingenuity, Dee defeats the bloodthirsty vampires and ultimately exposes the prince’s dark ambitions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Erin,一名飽受創傷與怒火困擾的女子,前往偏遠莊園探訪男友的家人,卻發現對方竟是操控血腥交易的邪教。當她被擄並成為獵物時,壓抑已久的怒火徹底爆發,反轉局勢,展開一場殘酷的求生之戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Erin, a troubled young woman with trauma and anger, travels to a remote estate to meet her boyfriend’s family. The visit turns into a nightmare when she discovers they are part of a blood cult. Abducted and marked for harvest, Erin unleashes a deadly rage, turning the hunt into a brutal fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛人不幸離世後,Neua開始學習猴型泰拳,誓言為她報仇。Neua愛人的妹妹懂中國功夫,起初懷疑Neua與姐姐的死有關,但後來發現姐姐實際上是被一個有組織的犯罪集團所殺。最終,兩人攜手合作,共同維護正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the tragic loss of his lover, Neua learns Monkey Muay Thai and vows to avenge her death. His lover’s sister, who practises Chinese Kung Fu, initially suspects Neua of being responsible, but later discovers that her sister was killed by an organised crime ring. Together, they join forces to uphold justice and seek vengeance.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍王被降龍大師封印了五百年,龍王之女為解除父親的封印,不惜穿越時空,回到五百年前殺掉降龍大師。但她沒想到五百年前的龍王與降龍大師竟是生死摯友…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當天才駭客Tara試圖阻止一個擁有自我意識的強大人工智能接管全球軍事系統時,她反被人工智能定性為必須剷除的恐怖分子……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the worlds military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: CIA探員Tara接受了一項祕密政府實驗,獲得以DNA轉換成任何人的能力,成為終極潛入者。然而,當父親遭到謀殺、線索竟指向她所屬的機構時,Tara被迫脫離組織、展開逃亡。如今,她必須阻止被竊的濃縮鈾引..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Extreme Ends是個動作冒險真人秀節目,邀請四位名人及其特別嘉賓一同體驗香港的多元魅力!讓我們跟隨印尼名模 Patricia 和 Chika 探索這座城市的隱秘寶藏和知名地標,沉浸在強烈對比的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Indonesian famous models Patricia and Chika as they explore the citys hidden gems and vibrant scenes, immersing themselves in amazing contrasts and trendy vibes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警探張荼為救落入人販之手的兒子,不惜孤身深入敵穴,跨國追擊,但卻被牽扯進大型兒童拐賣案。在尋找兒子的過程中,他和身份神秘的女子攜手搗毀了一個大型國際犯罪集團,上演了一場驚心動魄的絕地生死營救。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

Join Indonesian famous models Patricia and Chika as they explore the citys hidden gems and vibrant scenes, immersing themselves in amazing contrasts and trendy vibes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 警探張荼為救落入人販之手的兒子,不惜孤身深入敵穴,跨國追擊,但卻被牽扯進大型兒童拐賣案。在尋找兒子的過程中,他和身份神秘的女子攜手搗毀了一個大型國際犯罪集團,上演了一場驚心動魄的絕地生死營救。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 豪傑武松因揭發嫂子潘金蓮與西門慶的奸情而遭陷害,被迫刺配流放。當得知兄長武大郎慘遭毒殺後,武松悲憤回鄉討回公道,卻發現官府貪贓枉法,拒絕嚴懲真兇。面對黑白顛倒的世道,怒火中燒的武松決意血戰獅子樓,親手..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 龍王被降龍大師封印了五百年,龍王之女為解除父親的封印,不惜穿越時空,回到五百年前殺掉降龍大師。但她沒想到五百年前的龍王與降龍大師竟是生死摯友…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 電影講述清末上海的小人物陳真,在經歷苦難及面對無數挑戰後,蛻變成長為民族英雄的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕刺客青面修羅接受人生首份刺殺任務,同時暗中調查當年自己家族滅門慘案幕後起因。但任務還未完成,他發現自己已經捲入了一場策劃多年的陰謀當中,唯有利用自己的刺客技能,一一破局。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 曾是東北街頭武霸的阿能為了出人頭地,洗心革面來到香港的九龍城寨從零開始打拼,不料卻捲入一場黑惡勢力間的陰謀和混戰。最終為保護被黑惡勢力追殺的好朋友,阿能重拾自我,挺身而出,與城寨居民一同對抗黑惡勢力,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在萊咖國政權交替之際,黑幫頭目宋邦企圖藉此洗白身份,欲坐上市長寶座。為了籌措龐大資金,他與官員勾結行賄,卻仍面臨嚴重的資金缺口。於是,宋邦的得力助手鄭吒和打手蘇萬殺人越貨、橫行作惡,逐步幫助他鞏固權力..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and  his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 地下拳手林楓因拒絕替曼谷黑幫打黑拳,因此被追殺。他雖成功逃脫,卻失去記憶。當林楓開展其新生活時,卻被黑幫發現行蹤,並找來絕頂打手對付他。期間林楓忽然回復記憶,並誓要將黑幫殲滅。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武術宗師梁坤為保護心愛的女人毅然退隱江湖,不料他的隱忍卻換來了愛人的慘死。意識到宿命避無可避,他重返武林,在丐幫幫主蘇燦的鼎力相助下,梁坤殺出一條血路,誓要向那些冷血仇敵討回血債。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤練君在押解過程中逃脫,張道長亦因此被逐出師門。為追查赤煉君的下落,張道長來到一個地方,發現有很多平民無故失蹤。當張道長查出赤練君為練成蛇魔而抓走平民後,一場人魔大戰旋即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1917年,少年葉問初到香港求學。英文演講比賽當天,學校發生一宗驚天綁架案,全校同學都被挾持。面對眼前的危機,葉問挺身而出,發現綁匪竟然是自己的師父和好兄弟。少年葉問在危機時刻可否打敗綁匪,從而伸張正..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

As darkness closes in, Koy fights to reclaim her true identity and survive the ultimate test within her mind.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為一隻丟失的鸛群幼崽苦惱,與正在等級戰鬥的曼茲幼崽打成一片,了解吵鬧鄰居中的朋友和敵人.和朱爾茲一起在荒涼的不毛之地尋找失蹤的卡庫裡族群.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部野生動物紀錄片探索了被稱為珊德維爾德的西部與海岸.通過茂密的陸地植被和穿越苛刻的開放空間,又在水底下穿梭,在土地的並置中有甚麼生存條件呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A narrow and harsh belt of western coastline in southern Africa is a land of contrasts where creatures are forced to adapt to survive. Meet the quirky and charismatic inhabitants that call this fragile interplay between land and ocean home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春回大地,農場裡生機處處.雙胞胎羔羊拿利和科嬅,以及其他新生兒在草地上歡騰.小牛孤兒莫莉努力生活,而母豬姬絲則有一位情人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季意味著動物可以在空曠的草地上漫遊,也導致了海福特牛群的不和,還有黃牛間的戰鬥.赫布里底羊進行逃脫,倒霉的牧羊犬謝茜有了第一次驅攏的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性.公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位.母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場.母豬舒娜生下小豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸.這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中.這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化. 科學家們探索這個外星之境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河發源于青藏高原,穿越中國雲南省,這是我們旅程的起點.儘管雲南只占中國不到4%的土地,但這裡卻是超過一半的鳥類和哺乳動物的家園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of Chinas land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於泰國的湄公河沿岸是溫帶與熱帶的交界;跟隨攝製隊沿着河流穿越金三角,欣賞該區眾多鳥類的求偶舞,再一同參與水靈祭典.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekongs banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the regions abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索老撾甘蒙省壯麗的洞穴,這些位於湄公河和安南山脈之間的天然奇觀,是蝙蝠,壁虎,青蛙和巨型蜈蚣的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河沿著泰國東部邊境延伸,塑造了這片土地的地貌,形成數百條穿越叢林的小水道.走進這個巨大網絡之中,窺探恆河猴,大象和狐蝠如何在水邊和諧共處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the Mekong River travels down Thailands eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在享受偷來的盛宴時,躲避了一隻獵豹和曼茲狗群.但卡庫裡族群在狩獵中就沒這麼幸運了,因為它們被一隻勇敢的普庫羚羊挫敗了.找到鸛群,和朱爾斯和西蒙一起逃避衝鋒中的大象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dodge a leopard with the Manzi dogs while they treat themselves to a stolen feast. No such luck for the Kakuli pack on the hunt, as theyre foiled by a brave puku antelope. Find the stork pack, and retreat from charging elephants with Jules and Si...

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果小小的恩塞富獅群想要生存下去,族群中一對不合群的兄弟必須迅速掌握狩獵技巧,並要快速穿梭於敵人領地中,與霸氣的競爭對手和強大的鬣狗群作戰,以得着溫飽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫蒂姆爭分奪秒地救治無尾熊艾希莉,並拜會一隻需要獸醫馬丁額外照顧的狐蝠,因為牠多了一隻手指.與獸醫艾米莉一起照顧遭遇車禍的袋鼠幼寶寶,並評估牠們的生存機會,然後慶祝50隻吸蜜鸚鵡重返野外.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從修剪整齊的稻田到野性熱帶雨林,湄公河是泰國東部的生命之源.一起走訪河岸,看看長臂猿如何處理家庭糾紛,並暸解腹蛇如何為該區脆弱的生命網絡帶來威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果小小的恩塞富獅群想要生存下去,族群中一對不合群的兄弟必須迅速掌握狩獵技巧,並要快速穿梭於敵人領地中,與霸氣的競爭對手和強大的鬣狗群作戰,以得着溫飽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫蒂姆爭分奪秒地救治無尾熊艾希莉,並拜會一隻需要獸醫馬丁額外照顧的狐蝠,因為牠多了一隻手指.與獸醫艾米莉一起照顧遭遇車禍的袋鼠幼寶寶,並評估牠們的生存機會,然後慶祝50隻吸蜜鸚鵡重返野外.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從修剪整齊的稻田到野性熱帶雨林,湄公河是泰國東部的生命之源.一起走訪河岸,看看長臂猿如何處理家庭糾紛,並暸解腹蛇如何為該區脆弱的生命網絡帶來威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 和朱爾茲在捕獵行動中追上曼茲族群,和他一起拍攝一場野狗捕獵大戰;在卡庫裡族群冒著巨大的風險等待雨季到來時,留意獵豹和鬣狗的活動.與一隻歸來的鶴群公犬一起進行一次史詩般的狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Film a wild dog hunt with Julz as he catches up with the Manzi pack at a kill, and watch for leopards and hyenas as the Kakuli pack takes great risks while waiting for the rains to come. Go on an epic hunt with a returning male of the Stork Colony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 欣賞一對小企鵝哈利和莎莉的故事.這些不會飛,拍翼的鳥類創造了一些大自然中最嘈雜的社區.牠們是一個充滿忠誠關係,致力於維繫家庭和充滿活力夜生活的傳奇家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 柬埔寨被繫於湄公河的水域網絡之中,因此與這條大河的關係密不可分.看看這個國家如何展現生物多樣性,並見證動物族群如何在未受破壞的自然棲息地中找到秘密庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bisected by the Mekongs mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當朱爾茲滿懷感情地向狗群道別時,天上下起了雨.他欣慰地看到正在捕獵珍珠雞的鸛群幼崽,卡庫裡幼崽在吃羚羊屍體,頑皮的曼茲群在圍攻一隻頑強的疣豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome the rains as an emotional Julz says farewell to the dog packs. He discovers the Stork Colony pups hunting guinea fowl, and is heartened to find the Kakuli pups feeding on an antelope carcass. The playful Manzi pack corner a tough warthog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鴯鶓是澳洲最大的本土鳥類,也是僅次於非洲鴕鳥的世界第二大鳥類:高2米,步幅近3米,完全不能飛翔.牠生活在一個亂七八糟的世界中,由雌鳥主導,有著綠色的蛋,而人類則傾盡全力繁殖和撫養雛鳥,牠們被稱為史皮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Emu is Australias biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where fema...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓.深入探索並了解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨,甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong is Cambodias lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野外的生死大戰既激烈又無情.獵食或飢餓造成的死亡總是近在咫尺.有些動物通過變大或變快來適應這種環境,但其他動物進化出更有趣的能力.針鼴是一種非常奇怪的小動物,怪在牠們的繁殖能力.鞭蠍,也許是世界上最鮮為人知的蜘蛛綱動物.當牠受到威脅時,可以向捕食者射出刺鼻的醋酸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keep your distance from these natural-born killers. Armed with venom and other poisonous tools that make hunting easier (and escape impossible), nudibranches, cuttlefish, giant centipedes, and assassin bugs are all dressed to kill.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係.2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者.在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索.最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲的猛禽是該處最兇猛的捕食者之一.這些高度專業的殺手強大,足智多謀並十分觸目.牠們靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存.這是澳洲空中獵人的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australias birds of prey are some of the regions fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australias aerial hunters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地.大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final country on the Mekongs journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnams crown, a biological treasure trove.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係.2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者.在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索.最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲的猛禽是該處最兇猛的捕食者之一.這些高度專業的殺手強大,足智多謀並十分觸目.牠們靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存.這是澳洲空中獵人的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australias birds of prey are some of the regions fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australias aerial hunters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地.大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final country on the Mekongs journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnams crown, a biological treasure trove.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在殘酷的動物王國中,狡猾和蠻力決定了生存的一方.有些動物擁有強大的化武來增加生存機會.不同的化學物質有不同的用途:一些毒液能癱瘓獵物,而另一些則將捕食者內部變成容易消化的糊狀物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine the lives of creatures with really strange skills. From poison-shooting arachnids to ink-bombing octopuses to bifocal-eyed beetles, these animals use their powers to help them defeat predators and ensure their survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成功的繁殖對任何鳥類的生存來說都重要尤關,我們在本集會介紹四種鳥類,牠們竭力尋找配偶並撫養後代,為下一代提供最佳的生活機會.無論牠們生活在那裡,都有著一堆苦差,保護自己的領地免受入侵者侵害,吸引並贏得配偶,又要保護牠們的雛鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Whereve...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一.迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海.這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...
