epg.episode_synopsis_en: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Whereve...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一.迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海.這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係.2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者.在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索.最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇怪的生物「海洋怪球」是關於生活在海底的一些奇異和驚人的動物.生活在競爭激烈的環境中,代表著他們的進化之路歷盡奇怪的曲折,從擁有比子彈更快的前肢,到能夠隱藏在沙下伏擊毫無防備的獵物.這些動物以其令人印象深刻的適應力脫穎而出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into the lives of the oceans weirdest animals. Looking into a whitemargin stargazer fishs eyes can be a shocking experience (literally), while predators hoping to take down a peacock mantis shrimp will be stopped by its vice-like claws.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位處南非的西北端,這是一片與眾不同的沙漠.極端化景觀的存在證明了大自然能夠轉化和適應這片飢荒和豐饒的土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For most of the year its a desert, but during early August and September the dusty valleys of Namaqualand transform into a wonderland carpeted with wildflowers. Witness this magnificent transformation from arid desert to beautiful oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哈德遜灣低窪地是北美最大濕地的一部分. 超過300,000平方公里的厚苔沼,一處巨大的沼澤地,放眼望去可以看到以水浸泡的泥煤,苔蘚和矮木的特色生態.曾被視為荒地,但現在人們都知道這些沼澤對地球上的生命尤關重要.在全球的濕地中存在的二氧化碳跟大氣中一樣多,泥煤地生態系統是地球上最有效的碳吸儲庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wastela...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 育空地區是一片真正的荒野,是世上最後的荒野之一.這片遼闊土地的名字來自它最長的河流,該地區的土著居民骨池人稱之為「預官也」,或稱「大河」.育空河是北美第三長的河流,流經寬闊的山谷和狹窄的河道,向西北延展超過3000公里至狂風暴雨的白令海.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in No...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塔特南角的11月,冬天將至哈德遜灣的下西部海岸線,但原本應該在哈德遜灣出現的冰卻不見蹤影.2016年是有紀錄以來最溫暖的一年,11月下旬時,仍然比平均溫度高出10度.氣候變化肆虐北方,大海不能在接近冰點結冰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperatur...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索北領地的海岸和大堡礁豐富的水域資源.跟隨主持人莉茲穿越被淹沒的道路,碰見飢餓的鹽水鱷魚和水母,並查探眾多奇怪的致命生物為何會以這個偏遠地區為家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 告別熱帶地區,深入舒爽的南海岸水域.與威嚴的灰鯊,變化多端的墨魚和巨大的藍鯨相遇,並和企鵝和海獅一起玩樂.本集帶大家窺探這些海域蓬勃的生命力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旅程的最後一站,來到澳洲內陸沙漠與印度洋交匯處,探索一片炙熱的未知之境.跟隨莉茲深入海床,見證虎鯊,魔鬼魚和海龜如何應對生存威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫蒂姆爭分奪秒地救治無尾熊艾希莉,並拜會一隻需要獸醫馬丁額外照顧的狐蝠,因為牠多了一隻手指.與獸醫艾米莉一起照顧遭遇車禍的袋鼠幼寶寶,並評估牠們的生存機會,然後慶祝50隻吸蜜鸚鵡重返野外.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 欣賞一對小企鵝哈利和莎莉的故事.這些不會飛,拍翼的鳥類創造了一些大自然中最嘈雜的社區.牠們是一個充滿忠誠關係,致力於維繫家庭和充滿活力夜生活的傳奇家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鴯鶓是澳洲最大的本土鳥類,也是僅次於非洲鴕鳥的世界第二大鳥類:高2米,步幅近3米,完全不能飛翔.牠生活在一個亂七八糟的世界中,由雌鳥主導,有著綠色的蛋,而人類則傾盡全力繁殖和撫養雛鳥,牠們被稱為史皮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Emu is Australias biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where fema...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲的猛禽是該處最兇猛的捕食者之一.這些高度專業的殺手強大,足智多謀並十分觸目.牠們靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存.這是澳洲空中獵人的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australias birds of prey are some of the regions fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australias aerial hunters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成功的繁殖對任何鳥類的生存來說都重要尤關,我們在本集會介紹四種鳥類,牠們竭力尋找配偶並撫養後代,為下一代提供最佳的生活機會.無論牠們生活在那裡,都有著一堆苦差,保護自己的領地免受入侵者侵害,吸引並贏得配偶,又要保護牠們的雛鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Whereve...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解南美洲多變的氣候如何孕育更豐富多樣的生命.尋找亞馬遜雨林中能夠「呼吸」氧氣的樹木,追隨廣闊的雲河軌跡,並拜會能在猛烈紫外線下茁壯成長的紅鶴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾與豹同行,跟隨這些自然界的偽裝大師,隱沒於斯里蘭卡的叢林之中.深入了解這種強大的貓科獵手,如何完美適應島上炎熱乾燥的氣候,並學習牠們的追蹤和獵食技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解南美洲多變的氣候如何孕育更豐富多樣的生命.尋找亞馬遜雨林中能夠「呼吸」氧氣的樹木,追隨廣闊的雲河軌跡,並拜會能在猛烈紫外線下茁壯成長的紅鶴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在野外狩獵,躲避掠食者和交配不僅需要技能,還需要完美地適應身體各部分.在某些情況下,進化會把身體部位變成真正厲害的工具.在本集中,我們會遇到一些動物:擬態章魚,墨西哥鈍口螈,三種鳥類和指猴,牠們的身體部位使它們在生存戰中佔據優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Evolution has granted some animals a distinct advantage over their opponents. Investigate the perfect body-part mutations that have given wunderpus octopuses, axolotls, royal spoonbills, aye-ayes, and other creatures an edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的西南端有一個植物桃花園,一個被動植物覆蓋的山地世界.地球上沒有其他地方像令人難以置信的高告伯生物圈保護區,在細小的區域內有著比其他地方更多獨特的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africas wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一隻鴨子若沒有她的狗仔朋友搭載,就決不下水,一頭以為自己是野牛的大象,還有一群收養了一隻小鹿孤兒的母牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與更多動物朋友仔見面,包括夏洛特,她是一隻喜歡與豚鼠朋友華萊士一起洗澡的史納莎,還有名叫咸美殊的公羊,他喜歡離群溜出去跟一群乳牛住在一起.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一頭被救出的犀牛孤兒跟一隻貪玩的小狗和一隻充滿愛的綿羊成為朋友,一隻大兔子照料一頭精力旺盛的小羊,還有一隻箭豬幫助兩隻英國鬥牛犬為受傷動物復健.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,動物收容所的一隻小狗幫助被帶回的小獵豹為回到野外做準備,一隻受傷的猴子贏得一群冷漠狗隻的歡心,還有一隻喜歡與一群羊一起覓食孤獨的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬.在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從修剪整齊的稻田到野性熱帶雨林,湄公河是泰國東部的生命之源.一起走訪河岸,看看長臂猿如何處理家庭糾紛,並暸解腹蛇如何為該區脆弱的生命網絡帶來威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 柬埔寨被繫於湄公河的水域網絡之中,因此與這條大河的關係密不可分.看看這個國家如何展現生物多樣性,並見證動物族群如何在未受破壞的自然棲息地中找到秘密庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bisected by the Mekongs mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓.深入探索並了解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨,甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong is Cambodias lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地.大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final country on the Mekongs journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnams crown, a biological treasure trove.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一.迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海.這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在婆羅洲,明猩學園剛開始了一個全新學期.一起來見證新生布米努力集中注意力,害羞的倫巴邁出獨立的重要一步,並為明猩學生瓦倫蒂諾在大學的波折起步加油打氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumbas first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨剛畢業的貝尼,與同學蘇拉,梅里爾和威恩,一起展開明猩學園導賞團.拜訪剛報到的新生莫莉,並與納丁博士一起上課,看她如何為慢吞吞的布米和野孩子莫妮塔評分.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓.見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒塞西亞患上瘧疾,團隊正努力遏止疾病在明猩學園中蔓延,並評估代母斯里幫助布米的計劃.一起看看紅毛猩猩媽媽達普特對女同學的積極影響;並目暏令人震驚的食物偷竊事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sris plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 搜尋失踪的孤兒拉黑伊,並見證害羞的魯姆巴在築巢課上,嘗試使用她虛弱的左手.見證年輕的黛麗拉在課堂上如何教訓布米,並看看班尼和瓦倫蒂諾能否合格,最終贏得自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 恭喜明猩學園的應屆畢業生,並見證他們的茁壯成長!跟隨車隊前往典禮現場,見證團隊向每一位踏上新旅途的明猩朋友作真摯告別,然後舉行熱鬧的畢業慶祝活動!而莫莉和布米也成功升班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who arent all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為一隻丟失的鸛群幼崽苦惱,與正在等級戰鬥的曼茲幼崽打成一片,了解吵鬧鄰居中的朋友和敵人.和朱爾茲一起在荒涼的不毛之地尋找失蹤的卡庫裡族群.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Agonize over a lost Stork pack puppy, and tussle with Manzi pups who are sorting their place in the hierarchy, figuring out noisy-neighbor friends and foes. Hop on a search mission with Julz for the missing Kakuli pack in the desolate Badlands.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部野生動物紀錄片探索了被稱為珊德維爾德的西部與海岸.通過茂密的陸地植被和穿越苛刻的開放空間,又在水底下穿梭,在土地的並置中有甚麼生存條件呢?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A narrow and harsh belt of western coastline in southern Africa is a land of contrasts where creatures are forced to adapt to survive. Meet the quirky and charismatic inhabitants that call this fragile interplay between land and ocean home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春回大地,農場裡生機處處.雙胞胎羔羊拿利和科嬅,以及其他新生兒在草地上歡騰.小牛孤兒莫莉努力生活,而母豬姬絲則有一位情人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its spring, and the farm is bursting with new life. Watch a ewe give birth to twins, an orphaned Hereford calf struggle to find a surrogate mother, and the top hen nestle down in her maternity coop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏季意味著動物可以在空曠的草地上漫遊,也導致了海福特牛群的不和,還有黃牛間的戰鬥.赫布里底羊進行逃脫,倒霉的牧羊犬謝茜有了第一次驅攏的機會.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience life on the farm as things heat up for summer. Watch animals swelter in a rare heatwave, try to stay cool in the nearby freshwater stream, and stash supplies for fall.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性.公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位.母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場.母豬舒娜生下小豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Watch life on the farm adjust as the leaves start to turn, from the sheep whose woolly coats keep them warm during the first frost to the bees that feed on the last bit of nectar before hibernation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備.為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會.母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumns final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過馬修・麥康納的旁述,跟隨鯰魚,虎貓等當地生物的視角,展開一場奇妙之旅.讓我們一同讚頌德克薩斯州的地景風貌和野生動物,並深入了解保育工作對拯救德克薩斯州獨特棲息地的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star States landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas unique habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸.這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中.這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化. 科學家們探索這個外星之境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河發源于青藏高原,穿越中國雲南省,這是我們旅程的起點.儘管雲南只占中國不到4%的土地,但這裡卻是超過一半的鳥類和哺乳動物的家園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The source of the Mekong River is high up in the Tibetan plateau, from there it flows into Yunnan Province, China, where our journey begins. Even though Yunnan occupies less than 4% of Chinas land, it is home to over half of its birds and mammals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陡峭的山脈和熱帶季風塑造了湄公河流域的地貌,並一直延伸至老撾.一起探索這個豐富的生態系統,拜訪短尾獮猴,斑頂翡翠和黑冠長臂,並見證他們如何在這片福地上找到棲身之所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Steep mountains and tropical monsoons define the Mekong River valley on its route through Laos. Catch glimpses of the wildlife who find refuge in its vibrant ecosystems, from stump-tailed macaques to pied kingfishers to black-crested gibbons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於泰國的湄公河沿岸是溫帶與熱帶的交界;跟隨攝製隊沿着河流穿越金三角,欣賞該區眾多鳥類的求偶舞,再一同參與水靈祭典.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The temperate north meets the tropical south along the Mekongs banks in Thailand. Follow the river through the Golden Triangle and see the courtship dances of the regions abundant bird species. Then take in a festival honouring water spirits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索老撾甘蒙省壯麗的洞穴,這些位於湄公河和安南山脈之間的天然奇觀,是蝙蝠,壁虎,青蛙和巨型蜈蚣的棲身地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the stunning caves of Khammouane province in Laos. These natural wonders, squeezed between the Mekong River and the Annamite Range, are home to part-time and full-time residents, including bats, geckos, frogs, and giant centipedes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河沿著泰國東部邊境延伸,塑造了這片土地的地貌,形成數百條穿越叢林的小水道.走進這個巨大網絡之中,窺探恆河猴,大象和狐蝠如何在水邊和諧共處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the Mekong River travels down Thailands eastern border, it sculpts the land, creating hundreds of small waterways through the jungle. Take a trek though lands where rhesus macaques, elephants, and flying foxes live in harmony at the waters edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​帶你發現那座位於波濤之下,眾城之中最奇幻壯麗的城市,那裡是愛情滋長與通勤旅者聚集之地,珊瑚礁主幹道宛如繁忙街道,浪漫與遷徙生命在其中交錯如潮.跟隨一隻懷抱愛意的綠蠵龜,展開牠的尋愛旅程;坐下來,陪伴一位鶴鴕爸爸細心守護他那剛孵化的小寶寶們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the most fantastic city of them all lying beneath the waves, where romance and migratory commuters flood the coral reefs main highways. Follow a green sea turtle looking for love and sit in with a cassowary dad tending his newborn chicks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​感受盛夏降臨時的灼熱氣息,體型龐大的海蝸牛試圖抵禦一群貪吃珊瑚的海星幫派入侵.與礁鯊一同巡遊黑夜,尋找宵夜佳餚;驚嘆鸚哥魚如何巧妙變身,以滑溜偽裝度過危機四伏的漫漫長夜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel the heat of summers arrival as supersize sea snails try to fend off an invading gang of coral-hungry starfish. Accompany reef sharks as they prowl for a midnight meal and marvel at the slippery disguise a parrotfish uses to survive the night.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在享受偷來的盛宴時,躲避了一隻獵豹和曼茲狗群.但卡庫裡族群在狩獵中就沒這麼幸運了,因為它們被一隻勇敢的普庫羚羊挫敗了.找到鸛群,和朱爾斯和西蒙一起逃避衝鋒中的大象.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dodge a leopard with the Manzi dogs while they treat themselves to a stolen feast. No such luck for the Kakuli pack on the hunt, as theyre foiled by a brave puku antelope. Find the stork pack, and retreat from charging elephants with Jules and Si...

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果小小的恩塞富獅群想要生存下去,族群中一對不合群的兄弟必須迅速掌握狩獵技巧,並要快速穿梭於敵人領地中,與霸氣的競爭對手和強大的鬣狗群作戰,以得着溫飽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫蒂姆爭分奪秒地救治無尾熊艾希莉,並拜會一隻需要獸醫馬丁額外照顧的狐蝠,因為牠多了一隻手指.與獸醫艾米莉一起照顧遭遇車禍的袋鼠幼寶寶,並評估牠們的生存機會,然後慶祝50隻吸蜜鸚鵡重返野外.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從修剪整齊的稻田到野性熱帶雨林,湄公河是泰國東部的生命之源.一起走訪河岸,看看長臂猿如何處理家庭糾紛,並暸解腹蛇如何為該區脆弱的生命網絡帶來威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡.​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升.暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapt or perish in the coral streets as higher-than-normal temperatures make autumn cooling (and survival) more difficult. Shack up with a clownfish family and their sea anemone landlord, then see cleaner fish give manta rays a day at the spa.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果小小的恩塞富獅群想要生存下去,族群中一對不合群的兄弟必須迅速掌握狩獵技巧,並要快速穿梭於敵人領地中,與霸氣的競爭對手和強大的鬣狗群作戰,以得着溫飽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫蒂姆爭分奪秒地救治無尾熊艾希莉,並拜會一隻需要獸醫馬丁額外照顧的狐蝠,因為牠多了一隻手指.與獸醫艾米莉一起照顧遭遇車禍的袋鼠幼寶寶,並評估牠們的生存機會,然後慶祝50隻吸蜜鸚鵡重返野外.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從修剪整齊的稻田到野性熱帶雨林,湄公河是泰國東部的生命之源.一起走訪河岸,看看長臂猿如何處理家庭糾紛,並暸解腹蛇如何為該區脆弱的生命網絡帶來威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #5
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 和朱爾茲在捕獵行動中追上曼茲族群,和他一起拍攝一場野狗捕獵大戰;在卡庫裡族群冒著巨大的風險等待雨季到來時,留意獵豹和鬣狗的活動.與一隻歸來的鶴群公犬一起進行一次史詩般的狩獵.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Film a wild dog hunt with Julz as he catches up with the Manzi pack at a kill, and watch for leopards and hyenas as the Kakuli pack takes great risks while waiting for the rains to come. Go on an epic hunt with a returning male of the Stork Colony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 欣賞一對小企鵝哈利和莎莉的故事.這些不會飛,拍翼的鳥類創造了一些大自然中最嘈雜的社區.牠們是一個充滿忠誠關係,致力於維繫家庭和充滿活力夜生活的傳奇家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 柬埔寨被繫於湄公河的水域網絡之中,因此與這條大河的關係密不可分.看看這個國家如何展現生物多樣性,並見證動物族群如何在未受破壞的自然棲息地中找到秘密庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bisected by the Mekongs mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來認識小雌豹奇帕祖亞的魅力,她受到母親的悉心照顧,因此從未需要自己捕獵.這是她生命中第一次獨自生活,她能否絕地求生,培養出所需的狩獵技能?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its summer in the Gulf of Oman. The scorching Arabian sun heats the shallow waters to 86 degrees boosting the growth of algae across a vast coral reef. This attracts thousands of hungry herbivores creating a fish versus fish turf war.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 海龜是地球上最古老的動物之一.這些古老的海洋生物甚至早於恐龍出現.牠們已經相對地沒改變並存活了超過1億年.但現在所有七個倖存品種都瀕臨滅絕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 欣賞一對小企鵝哈利和莎莉的故事.這些不會飛,拍翼的鳥類創造了一些大自然中最嘈雜的社區.牠們是一個充滿忠誠關係,致力於維繫家庭和充滿活力夜生活的傳奇家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 柬埔寨被繫於湄公河的水域網絡之中,因此與這條大河的關係密不可分.看看這個國家如何展現生物多樣性,並見證動物族群如何在未受破壞的自然棲息地中找到秘密庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bisected by the Mekongs mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​當寒冬降臨之際,沁入骨髓的寒意讓原本熱鬧喧騰的珊瑚礁世界趨於沉靜.隨著鏡頭悠然緩行,你將與礁鯊一同漫遊,與章魚共度水下時光;還會探訪一處奇妙的珊瑚綠洲,靜靜地矗立在一艘古老船骸之上.別錯過條紋蛇鰻高超的「身分竊取」本領:牠能巧妙偽裝成兇猛的掠食者,以迷惑周遭的生物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get chills as winter descends, slowing down life on the bustling reef. Meander with reef sharks and octopuses, visit a coral oasis atop an old shipwreck, and spot a banded snake eels talent for identity theft when it disguises itself as a predator.

epg.programme_title_en: Wild Dogs: Running with the Pack 1 #6
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當朱爾茲滿懷感情地向狗群道別時,天上下起了雨.他欣慰地看到正在捕獵珍珠雞的鸛群幼崽,卡庫裡幼崽在吃羚羊屍體,頑皮的曼茲群在圍攻一隻頑強的疣豬.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Welcome the rains as an emotional Julz says farewell to the dog packs. He discovers the Stork Colony pups hunting guinea fowl, and is heartened to find the Kakuli pups feeding on an antelope carcass. The playful Manzi pack corner a tough warthog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是阿曼灣的夏天.熾熱的阿拉伯陽光將淺水區加熱到86度,促進了廣闊珊瑚礁上藻類的生長.這吸引了成千上萬飢腸轆轆的草食性動物,引發了一場魚類之間的角力.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sea turtle is one of the oldest animals on earth. These ancient mariners even pre-date the dinosaurs. They have existed, relatively unchanged, for over 100 million years. But now, all seven of the surviving species are endangered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與非洲森林象一同穿越納米比亞沙漠,窺探牠們如何在缺乏食物與遮蔽的環境中保持涼爽.了解這頭巨獸如何挑選特定植物充飢,挖掘水井,並翻越無盡的沙丘尋找珍貴水源.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trek across the Namibian desert with the bush elephant and learn how it keeps its cool in a place with little food or shade. Discover how this giant consumes specific plants, digs wells, and hikes endless dunes in a quest to find precious water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鴯鶓是澳洲最大的本土鳥類,也是僅次於非洲鴕鳥的世界第二大鳥類:高2米,步幅近3米,完全不能飛翔.牠生活在一個亂七八糟的世界中,由雌鳥主導,有著綠色的蛋,而人類則傾盡全力繁殖和撫養雛鳥,牠們被稱為史皮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Emu is Australias biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where fema...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓.深入探索並了解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨,甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong is Cambodias lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉.稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲.而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Experience unbelievable acts of courage and loyalty by creatures trying to survive in the remote wilderness of New Zealands South Island. Face forest penguins feast and famine cycles, and explore the tumultuous world of newborn sea lions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 野外的生死大戰既激烈又無情.獵食或飢餓造成的死亡總是近在咫尺.有些動物通過變大或變快來適應這種環境,但其他動物進化出更有趣的能力.針鼴是一種非常奇怪的小動物,怪在牠們的繁殖能力.鞭蠍,也許是世界上最鮮為人知的蜘蛛綱動物.當牠受到威脅時,可以向捕食者射出刺鼻的醋酸.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Keep your distance from these natural-born killers. Armed with venom and other poisonous tools that make hunting easier (and escape impossible), nudibranches, cuttlefish, giant centipedes, and assassin bugs are all dressed to kill.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer brings long, warm days for wildlife to thrive. Watch animals learn new skills, compete for mates, and escape predators as they try to make the most of the short season.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 非洲的秋天帶來機會.非洲毛皮海獅,白喉猴,變色龍和黑斑羚等對秋季有所反應.秋天引發了許多動物的生活變化.稀有生物露面,獵食者聚集起來製造優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As fall sweeps across America and trees are set ablaze with color, animals are faced with make-or-break decisions. Find out how bald eagles, beavers, and other creatures prepare for the colder, darker, and leaner months ahead.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪婆羅洲的紅樹林,與灣鱷一同航行,並見證牠們在盤根錯節的水生植物之間穿梭自如.了解牠們如何利用環境調節體溫,以及如何憑藉驚人的耐性一躍成為頂尖獵手.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate a mangrove forest in Borneo with the saltwater crocodile, which is perfectly suited to life among the watery roots. Discover how this reptile uses the environment to regulate its temperature and why its epic patience makes it a super hunter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係.2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者.在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索.最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲的猛禽是該處最兇猛的捕食者之一.這些高度專業的殺手強大,足智多謀並十分觸目.牠們靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存.這是澳洲空中獵人的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australias birds of prey are some of the regions fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australias aerial hunters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地.大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final country on the Mekongs journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnams crown, a biological treasure trove.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋.生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海.隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how winters arrival triggers animal survival instincts in southwestern New Zealand. Track dolphins as they move to warmer waters to give their calves a fighting chance, and join longfin eels on an epic migration to their spawning grounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在殘酷的動物王國中,狡猾和蠻力決定了生存的一方.有些動物擁有強大的化武來增加生存機會.不同的化學物質有不同的用途:一些毒液能癱瘓獵物,而另一些則將捕食者內部變成容易消化的糊狀物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine the lives of creatures with really strange skills. From poison-shooting arachnids to ink-bombing octopuses to bifocal-eyed beetles, these animals use their powers to help them defeat predators and ensure their survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻.歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成功的繁殖對任何鳥類的生存來說都重要尤關,我們在本集會介紹四種鳥類,牠們竭力尋找配偶並撫養後代,為下一代提供最佳的生活機會.無論牠們生活在那裡,都有著一堆苦差,保護自己的領地免受入侵者侵害,吸引並贏得配偶,又要保護牠們的雛鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Whereve...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一.迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海.這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 狗隻正在世界各地拯救生命.在南非機場,趕鳥的邊境牧羊犬正在防止鳥類與飛機發生潛在的破壞性碰撞.在英國鄉村,西班牙獵犬的非凡嗅覺和安那托利亞牧羊犬的天然保護本能在保護瀕危物種方面發揮著至關重要的救命作用.在美國亞特蘭大,一隻受虐的小狗被遺棄在街頭,但被動物服務公司救出後,牠幫助拯救了整個努力應對...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africas most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集集中在狗隻與其(大部份)人類拍檔間的卓越合作關係.2018年,一隻德國牧羊種的搜救犬與加州特遣隊和她的洛杉磯消防員拍檔被部署在蒙特西托尋找破壞性泥石流意外的倖存者.在英國,土地調查犬類拍檔- 西班牙獵犬與牠們的人類拍檔,使用牠們的鼻子進行地下水洩漏搜索.最後,同樣在英國,與一隻學會閱讀的聰...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teachers pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地.年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of s...

epg.programme_title_tc: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #1
epg.programme_title_en: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長.與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Longuro and see why six-year-old Keleles mysterious illness could delay his release.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 紅毛猩猩是叢林中的建築大師.跟隨麥克斯來到婆羅洲的雨林,一起探索這種獨居靈長類動物的築巢藝術.然後見證麥克斯如何嘗試逃離滿佈昆蟲的地面,並從紅毛猩猩身上學習自然界工程技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Investigate the art of nest making with the jungles master builder: the orangutan. Shadow Max as he tries to escape the insect-filled floor of the Borneo rainforest and takes inspiration from this solitary primates natural engineering prowess.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奇怪的生物「海洋怪球」是關於生活在海底的一些奇異和驚人的動物.生活在競爭激烈的環境中,代表著他們的進化之路歷盡奇怪的曲折,從擁有比子彈更快的前肢,到能夠隱藏在沙下伏擊毫無防備的獵物.這些動物以其令人印象深刻的適應力脫穎而出.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into the lives of the oceans weirdest animals. Looking into a whitemargin stargazer fishs eyes can be a shocking experience (literally), while predators hoping to take down a peacock mantis shrimp will be stopped by its vice-like claws.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位處南非的西北端,這是一片與眾不同的沙漠.極端化景觀的存在證明了大自然能夠轉化和適應這片飢荒和豐饒的土地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: For most of the year its a desert, but during early August and September the dusty valleys of Namaqualand transform into a wonderland carpeted with wildflowers. Witness this magnificent transformation from arid desert to beautiful oasis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 哈德遜灣低窪地是北美最大濕地的一部分. 超過300,000平方公里的厚苔沼,一處巨大的沼澤地,放眼望去可以看到以水浸泡的泥煤,苔蘚和矮木的特色生態.曾被視為荒地,但現在人們都知道這些沼澤對地球上的生命尤關重要.在全球的濕地中存在的二氧化碳跟大氣中一樣多,泥煤地生態系統是地球上最有效的碳吸儲庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North Americas largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wastela...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 育空地區是一片真正的荒野,是世上最後的荒野之一.這片遼闊土地的名字來自它最長的河流,該地區的土著居民骨池人稱之為「預官也」,或稱「大河」.育空河是北美第三長的河流,流經寬闊的山谷和狹窄的河道,向西北延展超過3000公里至狂風暴雨的白令海.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwichin, one of the indigenous people of the region, call Yu-kun- ah, or, the great river. The third longest waterway in No...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塔特南角的11月,冬天將至哈德遜灣的下西部海岸線,但原本應該在哈德遜灣出現的冰卻不見蹤影.2016年是有紀錄以來最溫暖的一年,11月下旬時,仍然比平均溫度高出10度.氣候變化肆虐北方,大海不能在接近冰點結冰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperatur...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索北領地的海岸和大堡礁豐富的水域資源.跟隨主持人莉茲穿越被淹沒的道路,碰見飢餓的鹽水鱷魚和水母,並查探眾多奇怪的致命生物為何會以這個偏遠地區為家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 告別熱帶地區,深入舒爽的南海岸水域.與威嚴的灰鯊,變化多端的墨魚和巨大的藍鯨相遇,並和企鵝和海獅一起玩樂.本集帶大家窺探這些海域蓬勃的生命力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 旅程的最後一站,來到澳洲內陸沙漠與印度洋交匯處,探索一片炙熱的未知之境.跟隨莉茲深入海床,見證虎鯊,魔鬼魚和海龜如何應對生存威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Complete the trips final lap in the untamed lands where Australias interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫蒂姆爭分奪秒地救治無尾熊艾希莉,並拜會一隻需要獸醫馬丁額外照顧的狐蝠,因為牠多了一隻手指.與獸醫艾米莉一起照顧遭遇車禍的袋鼠幼寶寶,並評估牠們的生存機會,然後慶祝50隻吸蜜鸚鵡重返野外.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 欣賞一對小企鵝哈利和莎莉的故事.這些不會飛,拍翼的鳥類創造了一些大自然中最嘈雜的社區.牠們是一個充滿忠誠關係,致力於維繫家庭和充滿活力夜生活的傳奇家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 鴯鶓是澳洲最大的本土鳥類,也是僅次於非洲鴕鳥的世界第二大鳥類:高2米,步幅近3米,完全不能飛翔.牠生活在一個亂七八糟的世界中,由雌鳥主導,有著綠色的蛋,而人類則傾盡全力繁殖和撫養雛鳥,牠們被稱為史皮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Emu is Australias biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where fema...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 澳洲的猛禽是該處最兇猛的捕食者之一.這些高度專業的殺手強大,足智多謀並十分觸目.牠們靠著一些令人印象深刻的武器而生存.這是澳洲空中獵人的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Australias birds of prey are some of the regions fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australias aerial hunters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 成功的繁殖對任何鳥類的生存來說都重要尤關,我們在本集會介紹四種鳥類,牠們竭力尋找配偶並撫養後代,為下一代提供最佳的生活機會.無論牠們生活在那裡,都有著一堆苦差,保護自己的領地免受入侵者侵害,吸引並贏得配偶,又要保護牠們的雛鳥.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Whereve...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解南美洲多變的氣候如何孕育更豐富多樣的生命.尋找亞馬遜雨林中能夠「呼吸」氧氣的樹木,追隨廣闊的雲河軌跡,並拜會能在猛烈紫外線下茁壯成長的紅鶴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索月相如何為捕食者和獵物之間無盡的競爭設定節奏.與飛鼠一起在月光下翱翔,與猕猴一起大快朵頤海鮮盛宴,並觀察一群潛行的獅子如何試圖將一隻小象變成晚餐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​造訪星空下浪漫與冒險的世界.愛上鼠尾草雞的求偶舞蹈,看到一對北極狐情侶重聚,在珊瑚礁中漂浮於產卵魚之間,並參觀鐵匠樹蛙在月光下的繁殖池.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程.看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥克斯來到盧安達的森林追蹤黑猩猩,他試圖說服這些強壯的猴子相信他是朋友而非敵人.一起學習在叢林覓食的關鍵技巧,並見證黑猩猩複雜的家庭動態,包括梳理毛髮和社交活動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that hes a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界.見證這種看似人畜無害,毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集帶觀眾與豹同行,跟隨這些自然界的偽裝大師,隱沒於斯里蘭卡的叢林之中.深入了解這種強大的貓科獵手,如何完美適應島上炎熱乾燥的氣候,並學習牠們的追蹤和獵食技巧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解南美洲多變的氣候如何孕育更豐富多樣的生命.尋找亞馬遜雨林中能夠「呼吸」氧氣的樹木,追隨廣闊的雲河軌跡,並拜會能在猛烈紫外線下茁壯成長的紅鶴.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在野外狩獵,躲避掠食者和交配不僅需要技能,還需要完美地適應身體各部分.在某些情況下,進化會把身體部位變成真正厲害的工具.在本集中,我們會遇到一些動物:擬態章魚,墨西哥鈍口螈,三種鳥類和指猴,牠們的身體部位使它們在生存戰中佔據優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Evolution has granted some animals a distinct advantage over their opponents. Investigate the perfect body-part mutations that have given wunderpus octopuses, axolotls, royal spoonbills, aye-ayes, and other creatures an edge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在非洲的西南端有一個植物桃花園,一個被動植物覆蓋的山地世界.地球上沒有其他地方像令人難以置信的高告伯生物圈保護區,在細小的區域內有著比其他地方更多獨特的物種.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africas wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一隻鴨子若沒有她的狗仔朋友搭載,就決不下水,一頭以為自己是野牛的大象,還有一群收養了一隻小鹿孤兒的母牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與更多動物朋友仔見面,包括夏洛特,她是一隻喜歡與豚鼠朋友華萊士一起洗澡的史納莎,還有名叫咸美殊的公羊,他喜歡離群溜出去跟一群乳牛住在一起.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一頭被救出的犀牛孤兒跟一隻貪玩的小狗和一隻充滿愛的綿羊成為朋友,一隻大兔子照料一頭精力旺盛的小羊,還有一隻箭豬幫助兩隻英國鬥牛犬為受傷動物復健.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,動物收容所的一隻小狗幫助被帶回的小獵豹為回到野外做準備,一隻受傷的猴子贏得一群冷漠狗隻的歡心,還有一隻喜歡與一群羊一起覓食孤獨的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬.在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從修剪整齊的稻田到野性熱帶雨林,湄公河是泰國東部的生命之源.一起走訪河岸,看看長臂猿如何處理家庭糾紛,並暸解腹蛇如何為該區脆弱的生命網絡帶來威脅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the regions delicate living networks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 柬埔寨被繫於湄公河的水域網絡之中,因此與這條大河的關係密不可分.看看這個國家如何展現生物多樣性,並見證動物族群如何在未受破壞的自然棲息地中找到秘密庇護所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bisected by the Mekongs mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​湄公河是柬埔寨的生命線,尤其是在酷熱難耐的旱季,寶貴的水分幾乎難以尋覓.深入探索並了解各式各樣能展翅飛翔的生物,無論是鳥類還是蝙蝠,牠們在缺水的漫長日子裡,善加運用並精打細算管理僅有的資源,直到雨季降臨,甘甜的雨水帶來久違的慰藉與舒緩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong is Cambodias lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河之旅的最後一個國家是湄公河三角洲的發源地.大量營養豐富的物質從數百里外的河流順流而下,使此地成為越南皇冠上的掌上明珠,也是一座生物寶庫.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final country on the Mekongs journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnams crown, a biological treasure trove.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 湄公河三角洲是地球上最大的三角洲之一.迄今已有8000年之久,其呈扇形延伸,通過九條水道綿延流入南海.這些水道分割並塑造了海岸線,為各種動物創造了獨特的棲息地.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在婆羅洲,明猩學園剛開始了一個全新學期.一起來見證新生布米努力集中注意力,害羞的倫巴邁出獨立的重要一步,並為明猩學生瓦倫蒂諾在大學的波折起步加油打氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumbas first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨剛畢業的貝尼,與同學蘇拉,梅里爾和威恩,一起展開明猩學園導賞團.拜訪剛報到的新生莫莉,並與納丁博士一起上課,看她如何為慢吞吞的布米和野孩子莫妮塔評分.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓.見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒塞西亞患上瘧疾,團隊正努力遏止疾病在明猩學園中蔓延,並評估代母斯里幫助布米的計劃.一起看看紅毛猩猩媽媽達普特對女同學的積極影響;並目暏令人震驚的食物偷竊事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sris plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 搜尋失踪的孤兒拉黑伊,並見證害羞的魯姆巴在築巢課上,嘗試使用她虛弱的左手.見證年輕的黛麗拉在課堂上如何教訓布米,並看看班尼和瓦倫蒂諾能否合格,最終贏得自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 恭喜明猩學園的應屆畢業生,並見證他們的茁壯成長!跟隨車隊前往典禮現場,見證團隊向每一位踏上新旅途的明猩朋友作真摯告別,然後舉行熱鬧的畢業慶祝活動!而莫莉和布米也成功升班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who arent all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

epg.programme_title_tc: 人性之猿:豐戈利黑猩猩 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨人類學家吉爾普魯茨及嚮導東多康德,即場見證演化在眼前發生.走進塞內加爾豐戈利,認識一群行蹤隱秘的黑猩猩,牠們懂得使用工具,與火互動,並在與人類世界不斷交會之際,展現出驚人的適應能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在婆羅洲,明猩學園剛開始了一個全新學期.一起來見證新生布米努力集中注意力,害羞的倫巴邁出獨立的重要一步,並為明猩學生瓦倫蒂諾在大學的波折起步加油打氣.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumbas first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨剛畢業的貝尼,與同學蘇拉,梅里爾和威恩,一起展開明猩學園導賞團.拜訪剛報到的新生莫莉,並與納丁博士一起上課,看她如何為慢吞吞的布米和野孩子莫妮塔評分.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓.見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet some late-life lovers and explore the reasons behind their sexual longevity and their ability to reproduce well into their later years.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港.每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and its up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What does it take to maintain alpha status as animals grow older? We investigate the responsibilities and challenges that come with being a senior leader of a pack.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類,植物,動物,細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點:死亡.我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大象團隊在今集迎來令人震驚的消息,獸醫們擔心他們救助的一隻小企鵝,我們也瞭解到如何真正需要一個社區來為動物園提供食物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This time on Wild Heroes, theres shocking news for the elephant team, the vets are concerned about one of their rescued Little penguins, and we find out how it really does take a community to feed the Zoo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新加坡,馬克·威廉士加入菲力普斯雙胞胎的行列,他們騎著側邊車穿越唐人街,體驗舞獅,並搭乘渡輪前往烏敏島劃劃皮艇穿梭紅樹林.在這趟刺激的旅程中,他們還深入探索了娘惹文化,歷史文物與在地美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Mark Williams in Singapore, the Phelps twins ride sidecars through Chinatown, try Lion Dancing, and ferry to Pulau Ubin to kayak the mangroves. They also explore Peranakan culture, artifacts, and local cuisine on this thrilling trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與嘉賓柯瑞·米克利斯特一起,詹姆斯和奧利弗造訪了墨爾本.他們遊覽雅拉河,觀賞菲利普島的小企鵝,駕駛卡丁車,乘坐普芬比利蒸汽火車,在貝爾斯海灘體驗衝浪課程,還在一架二戰老式飛機上上演空中特技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With guest Corey Mylchreest, James and Oliver explore Melbourne. They cruise the Yarra River, see Phillip Islands penguins, race go-karts, ride Puffing Billy, take a surf lesson at Bell’s Beach, and perform stunts in a WWII plane.

epg.programme_title_tc: 哈裡遜福特:好萊塢英雄
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個人都認為自己熟悉夏裡遜福.他們認識富有冒險精神的反納粹考古學家和反烏託邦未來的銀翼殺手.但一旦停下攝錄機,就沒有人真正瞭解演員的真實人生了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Everyone thinks they know Harrison Ford. They know the adventurous Nazi-fighting archaeologist and the Blade Runner from a dystopian future. But nobody really knows the man behind the movies once the cameras have stopped rolling.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從出身卑微到成為有抱負的演員,再到扮演世上最具標誌性和最著名的角色.他贏得了美國好人,平民和藝術遊牧民的美譽.而我們都知道他......是 湯姆漢克斯.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings to an aspiring thespian to acting as some of the world’s most iconic and notable characters. He has picked up a reputation as America’s Nice Guy, The Everyman and a nomad of the arts. But we all know him... as Tom Hanks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集講述了這些雄偉的座頭鯨的旅程,從覓食地到繁殖地,母鯨與幼鯨之間的溫柔時光,以及幼鯨在最初幾個月面臨的危險,包括與食肉鯨的驚人互動.座頭鯨還面臨著一個充滿人類威脅的世界,從大型貨櫃船到尋找石油和天然氣時地震測試的影響,現在這些威脅再次威脅到它們的生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode follows the journeys of these magnificent humpbacks, from their feeding grounds to their breeding grounds, the tender moments between mother and calf, and see the dangers their calves face in their first few months, including incredible

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界.我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Often referred to as the dinosaur fish, the coelacanth occupies a unique place in the fossil record, and when it was rediscovered almost a century ago it shook the scientific community. We follow its journey to the present day, accompanying WildOcean

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《兩條鯊魚的故事》中,我們將看看南非海岸發現的各種各樣的鯊魚,重點關注瀕臨滅絕的路氏雙髻鯊和標誌性的大白鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In A Tale Of Two Sharks we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭,翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩,侏儒象,長鼻猴,犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deep dive into Borneo’s heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode well meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. Well dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
