epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類,植物,動物,細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點:死亡.我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 文拿探索他加拿大的後院,發現美味的素壽司,開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mena explores his Canadian backyard, discovering delicious plant-based sushi, pistachio cannolis, and pizza; he gets hands-on at a vegan cheese factory with comedian Bassem Youssef.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好萊塢以鐵蝴蝶聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Best known in Hollywood as The Iron Butterfly - Julie Andrews has garnered numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over seven decades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息.歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機.這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣.第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary series shows five generations of jet engines. These fighter jets are capable of carrying bombs and soar close to the edge of space. The sixth generation of fighter jets began in 2020, and the 11th season has covered most of the air a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰.這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Being just that little bit different, can bring huge advantages, but it also presents almighty challenges. By going against the grain, these animals have found unique ways to stay alive.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 春天來了,遷徙的魚鷹重返公園.懷孕的歐洲馬鹿下山到低地產子.兩隻大公雞在山腰為了爭奪交配權,而展開一場名為力的奇觀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is spring, and migrating ospreys return to the park. Pregnant red deer come down from the mountain tops to the lowlands to calve. On a mountainside, two big cocks fight for the right to mate in a spectacle called a lek.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中.溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥,覓食和躲避掠食者.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: It is now June, and the park is bathed in 17 hours of daylight. With the warm temperatures come rich pickings, but for the newborn the summer months are crucial as they learn to fight, find food and avoid predators.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息.歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s primate team prepare to welcome a new birth.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李奧納多·狄卡皮歐與湯姆·哈迪主演阿利安卓·崗札雷·伊納利圖執導的這部史詩級震撼巨作.故事根據真實事件改編,背景設定在美國未開墾的荒野,講述一段關於生存與背叛的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio and Tom Hardy star in Alejandro González Iñárritus visceral, epic tale of survival and betrayal inspired by true events thats set in Americas uncharted wilderness.

epg.programme_title_tc: 李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路
epg.programme_title_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: Road To The Revenant
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《李奧納多狄卡皮歐:崛起之路》紀錄了他從崛起新星到影壇傳奇的歷程.在突破性角色,與史柯西斯的合作以及對環保倡議的推動下,他對卓越藝術的執著追求最終讓他榮獲奧斯卡影帝殊榮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leonardo DiCaprio: The Road to The Revenant traces his rise from breakout star to cinema icon. Driven by bold roles, Scorsese collaborations, and eco-advocacy, his relentless pursuit of artistic excellence culminates in an epic Oscar win.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.programme_title_tc: 妮可基嫚: 走向奧斯卡
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部專題紀錄片聚焦澳洲傳奇 Nicole Kidman 的早年生活,電影事業,以及她所經歷的高低起伏.從叢林中的聖誕節到奧斯卡得主,她的故事充滿啟發與考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feature documentary about the early life, filmic career, and trials and tribulations of Australian icon, Nicole Kidman. From a Bush Christmas to Oscar winning performances, her story is one of inspiration and hardship.

epg.programme_title_tc: 茱莉亞羅勃茲:美麗標誌
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生.從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the extraordinary life of Julia Roberts, Hollywood’s beloved icon. From her breakout role in Pretty Woman to her Oscar-winning performances, this documentary explores her journey, enduring charm, and impact on cinema, capturing the heart of

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當我們想到好萊塢芸芸眾多藝人時......有一個名字脫穎而出.從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報......這就是小勞勃道尼
epg.episode_synopsis_en: When we think of a prolific, yet tumultuous career in Hollywood... A name stands out amongst the crowd. From his hardships to his incredible retribution... This is Robert Downey Jr.

epg.programme_title_tc: 傳奇拳王: 曼尼帕奎奧
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是拳擊界最勢不可擋的力量之一的非凡旅程.曼尼柏基奧的傳奇將因其在拳擊場內外所實現的變革而被永遠銘記......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This is the remarkable journey of one of boxing’s most unstoppable forces. Manny Pacquiao’s legacy will forever be remembered for the change accomplished inside and outside the ring...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 剛登六的湯姆克魯斯仍然是好萊塢頂流之一.作為一位多產的演員,他的職業生涯橫跨40年,不斷在電影界創造巨大的遺產.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Having just turned 60, Tom Cruise is still one of the leading names in Hollywood. A prolific actor with a career spanning over 40 years, he is continually building a giant legacy within the film industry.

epg.programme_title_tc: 布萊德彼特:突破好萊塢
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 他可能是最性感的好萊塢演員之一,但他的職業和個人目標比他的外表更有味道.布萊德彼特.整個好萊塢首屈一指的人物之一.一個默默無聞的天才轉變為超級巨星的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: He may be one of the sexiest Hollywood actors, but his career and personal goals offer much more than his looks. Brad Pitt. One of the leading names in all of Hollywood. The well-known story of an unknown talent who transformed into a superstar.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳狄翁不用多作介紹.除了成功外,她的私人生活充斥痛苦的悲劇.她的故事關於力量,堅韌和愛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Céline Dion is a name that needs no introduction. Beyond the success, her personal life has been marked with a painful amount of tragedy. Her story is one of strength, resilience and love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好萊塢以鐵蝴蝶聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Best known in Hollywood as 「The Iron Butterfly」 - Julie Andrews has garnered numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over seven decades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一趟視覺震撼的俯瞰之旅,帶您橫跨非洲,澳洲與斯堪地那維亞三大絕美勝地.全程採用 4K 攝影機精細捕捉,精緻刻畫出廣袤多元的壯麗地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A visually stunning aerial journey following three great destinations - Africa, Australia and Scandinavia. Beautifully filmed with a series of 4K cameras over the length and breadth of diverse landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭,翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩,侏儒象,長鼻猴,犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deep dive into Borneo’s heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美在帕華普週末市集的檔攤品嚐達爾文的流行街頭小食;並討論達爾文對叻沙的迷戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy gets a taste of Darwins popular street food from the stalls of the Parap Saturday market; Jimmy discusses Darwins laksa obsession.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美跟卡卡杜的風景打卡;他與原住民梅曼迪聊天,他帶著佔美沿著黃水河遊船河飽覽她的國家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裡奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Darwins only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: What if Bitcoin mining could actually save the world? Over this episode, we meet the local company on a mission to use it to help solve global warming.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智慧.這是能震撼你的一集.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We profile Kaye-Maree Dunn, an innovator developing digital data sovereignty and we find out how NFTs can allow us to own our own artificial intelligence. Its an episode that will blow your mind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集探索加密貨幣的基礎,並與當地冒著一切風險的加密貨幣先驅面談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we explore the foundations of Cryptocurrency and talk to the local crypto pioneers who risked it all.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族.我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Now we know why Crypto is such a big deal, through this episode well meet the family behind one of NZ’s biggest Crypto success stories. Well dispel some crypto myths and cover the basics of how to get on board.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執行長亞倫麥當勞和聯合創始人卜候活史密夫告訴我們他們如何在紐西蘭創立價值數百萬美元的非同質化代幣業務,並與國際巨星合作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: CEO Aaron McDonald and Co-Founder Brooke Howard-Smith tell us how they created a multi-million dollar NFT business here in Aotearoa and are collaborating with international superstars.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是勵志的一集,我們花時間與團隊一起將毛利人帶到元宇宙,並了解一些當地的顛覆者,他們關注打造每個人都有歸屬感的數碼世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Its an inspirational episode, we spend time with the team taking Māori to the metaverse and check-in on a couple of local disrupters focused on making digital worlds where everyone feels like they can belong.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨澳洲主廚馬西莫·梅勒在《大廚的後花園》中探索塔斯馬尼亞的鮮美在地食材.從自製義大利土豆糰子(Gnocchi)到野生鮑魚,一同發現他最愛的食譜,展現這座島嶼豐富的飲食寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Australian chef Massimo Mele as he explores Tasmanias fresh local produce in The Chefs Garden. Discover his favorite recipes, from homemade Italian gnocchi to fresh ocean abalone, highlighting the islands rich culinary treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬西莫走訪工廠與農田,揭開塔斯馬尼亞起司,橄欖與農園新鮮作物的美味秘訣.隨後,他展現高超廚藝,打造出從前菜到麵食的三道精緻義式佳餚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massimo visits factories and farmlands to reveal the secrets behind Tasmanian cheeses, olives, and garden-fresh produce. He then demonstrates his culinary skills by making three delicious Italian dishes, from appetizers to pasta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 主廚馬西莫·梅勒深入探尋塔斯馬尼亞頂級在地食材,包括備受推崇的放牧豬肉香菇香腸與現採新鮮蘑菇.一路上,他烹調出令人垂涎的柴燒披薩與自製手捲麵(Cavatelli).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chef Massimo Mele explores Tassies finest local ingredients, including prized free-range pork sausages and freshly picked mushrooms. Along the way, he cooks mouthwatering recipes like wood-fired pizza and homemade cavatelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 馬西莫將彤戈拉(Tongola)山羊奶起司與新鮮農園甜菜根及蔬菜搭配,完美展現從農場到餐桌的飲食理念.接著,他與在地農夫一同潛入清澈的塔斯馬尼亞海域,品嚐世界上最優質的生蠔.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Massimo showcases farm-to-table dining by pairing Tongola goat curd with fresh garden beetroot and vegetables. He then heads into clear Tasmanian waters with local farmers to sample some of the finest oysters in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本季最終集,馬西莫與漁夫布萊恩·丹尼出海,捕撈珍貴的南部巖石龍子.最後,他精心準備了兩道深受家族喜愛的甜點--義式奶凍(Panna Cotta)與義式炸甜甜圈(Zeppole),為這趟美食冒險畫下甜蜜句點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the season finale, Massimo sails with fisherman Bryan Denny to catch prized Southern Rock Lobster. He completes his culinary adventure on a sweet note by preparing two cherished family favorites: panna cotta and zeppole.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨澳洲主廚馬西莫·梅勒在《大廚的後花園》中探索塔斯馬尼亞的鮮美在地食材.從自製義大利土豆糰子(Gnocchi)到野生鮑魚,一同發現他最愛的食譜,展現這座島嶼豐富的飲食寶藏.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Australian chef Massimo Mele as he explores Tasmanias fresh local produce in The Chefs Garden. Discover his favorite recipes, from homemade Italian gnocchi to fresh ocean abalone, highlighting the islands rich culinary treasures.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新加坡,馬克·威廉士加入菲力普斯雙胞胎的行列,他們騎著側邊車穿越唐人街,體驗舞獅,並搭乘渡輪前往烏敏島劃劃皮艇穿梭紅樹林.在這趟刺激的旅程中,他們還深入探索了娘惹文化,歷史文物與在地美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Mark Williams in Singapore, the Phelps twins ride sidecars through Chinatown, try Lion Dancing, and ferry to Pulau Ubin to kayak the mangroves. They also explore Peranakan culture, artifacts, and local cuisine on this thrilling trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與嘉賓柯瑞·米克利斯特一起,詹姆斯和奧利弗造訪了墨爾本.他們遊覽雅拉河,觀賞菲利普島的小企鵝,駕駛卡丁車,乘坐普芬比利蒸汽火車,在貝爾斯海灘體驗衝浪課程,還在一架二戰老式飛機上上演空中特技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With guest Corey Mylchreest, James and Oliver explore Melbourne. They cruise the Yarra River, see Phillip Islands penguins, race go-karts, ride Puffing Billy, take a surf lesson at Bell’s Beach, and perform stunts in a WWII plane.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在好萊塢以鐵蝴蝶聞名的茱莉安德魯斯,在她七十載的職業生涯中獲得無數讚譽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Best known in Hollywood as The Iron Butterfly - Julie Andrews has garnered numerous accolades throughout her career spanning over seven decades.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一部講述歌影戲劇三棲最具魅力人物之一的麗莎明妮莉令人難以置信的生活和職業生涯的傳記式紀錄片.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一趟視覺震撼的俯瞰之旅,帶您橫跨非洲,澳洲與斯堪地那維亞三大絕美勝地.全程採用 4K 攝影機精細捕捉,精緻刻畫出廣袤多元的壯麗地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A visually stunning aerial journey following three great destinations - Africa, Australia and Scandinavia. Beautifully filmed with a series of 4K cameras over the length and breadth of diverse landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧克蘭動物園的獸醫團隊開始進行加護治療來拯救一隻被魚線纏住的瀕危海龜的生命.在動物園欠缺老虎三年後,團隊準備好迎接一隻新的大貓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Auckland Zoo’s vet team commences critical care to save the life of an endangered sea turtle snared on a fishing line, and after 3 years without tigers at the Zoo, the team stand by to welcome a new big cat.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖,魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英裡西非遷徙,三文魚返回牠們出生的河流,極北蝰產子的季節.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Autumn is when stags compete to breed, osprey chicks begin a 3000-mile migration to West Africa, salmon return to the rivers where they were born and adders give birth to live young.

epg.programme_title_en: Loch Lomond: A Year In The Wild #4
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息.歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The winter is mild and wet, which is good news for some but bad news for others. Red deer are forced to higher ground, salmon have gone six months without food, mountain hares turn a conspicuous white, and squirrels kick their own young out of the ne

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《納萊迪:小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Naledi follows the journey of a baby elephant orphaned in a rescue camp, as the man tasked with her survival races to protect an entire species while fighting to save her life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裡奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Darwins only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由製造花札卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平臺.這就是任天堂的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings manufacturing Hanufuda cards came one of the worlds most recognised videogame companies and presenting itself as a platform for quality games and strong values. This is the story of Nintendo.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #7
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣前往世上最大的自動化包裹分類設施 - 位於肯塔基州路易維爾的聯合包裹服務公司世界港.每天有200萬個包裹途經這裡,全靠幕後一班戴著安全帽的英雄實現這一切.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world - UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky. Two million packages go through here every day, and its up to the hardhat heroes behind the scenes to make it all happen.

epg.programme_title_en: How Did They Fix That? S2 #8
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 米克大衛臣在費城的街道,隧道,軌道和電車修車庫中與團隊並肩合作,使美國最大,最古老的大眾交通系統之一暢順並準時運作.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Philadelphia, Mike Davidson is on streets, in tunnels, on tracks and in trolley restoration garages - working shoulder-to-shoulder with the team that keeps one of Americas largest and oldest mass transit systems running smoothly and on time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness how Americas South and Midwest were ravaged by 148 twisters in just 18 hours.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒂娜透娜是我們這個時代最偉大的表演者之一,她那具爆發力的嗓音,令人興奮的舞臺表演和啟發性的人生故事俘虜全球數百萬人的心靈.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 芭芭拉史翠珊以其高亢,精緻的嗓音本事和魅力四射的個性,使她成為一生中最具創意和商業上最成功的表演者之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With her highly resonant and sophisticated vocal prowess and charismatic personality, Barbra Streisand rose to fame as one of the most creatively and commercially successful performers of her lifetime.

epg.programme_title_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格:為行動而生
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從塔爾(Thal)的平凡起點,到成為好萊塢最響亮的名字之一.他以健美運動員出身,隨後轉戰演藝界與政壇,這就是傳奇動作巨星阿諾·史瓦辛格(Arnold Schwarzenegger)的一生與諸多考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From humble beginnings in Thal to becoming one of the biggest names in Hollywood. He began as a bodybuilder, he turned to acting and politics, this is the life and many trials of the legendary action star, Arnold Schwarzenegger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一趟視覺震撼的俯瞰之旅,帶您橫跨非洲,澳洲與斯堪地那維亞三大絕美勝地.全程採用 4K 攝影機精細捕捉,精緻刻畫出廣袤多元的壯麗地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A visually stunning aerial journey following three great destinations - Africa, Australia and Scandinavia. Beautifully filmed with a series of 4K cameras over the length and breadth of diverse landscapes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一趟視覺震撼的俯瞰之旅,帶您橫跨非洲,澳洲與斯堪地那維亞三大絕美勝地.全程採用 4K 攝影機精細捕捉,精緻刻畫出廣袤多元的壯麗地貌.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: We explore the integral role that older animals play in their communities and investigate how animals learn over the course of their lives.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 人類,植物,動物,細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點:死亡.我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Human, plant, animal, bacteria, all have one inevitable thing in common; death. In this episode we discover the ways in which aging animals defy our usual understanding of the circle of life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食:炸雞,巨大無比的餅乾,排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Deep in the heart of Texas is a vegan oasis; Mena explores the off-beat Texan Capitols surprising plant-based bounty: fried chicken, larger-than-life biscuits, short rib baos and mouth-watering vegan brisket.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往繁忙的湍溪市場,穿梭在熟食檔,農夫和每週採購的當地人之間.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy heads to the bustling Rapid Creek markets, mingling amongst the food stalls, produce growers, and locals out for their weekly shop.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美拜訪一些正為希臘文化節準備食物的希臘社區;他到訪色彩繽紛的馬拉克夜市.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy meets some of the Greek community preparing food for the Greek cultural festival; he visits the colourful Malak Night Market.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美解釋為何北領地頂端地帶擁有全國最好,最新鮮的海鮮;他在達爾文碼頭遇到自學成才的廚師瑞秋西索卡,並學習如何烹製她的招牌菜- 檸檬柚子泥蟹.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy explains why the Top End has some of the countrys best and freshest seafood; Jimmy meets self-taught chef Rachael Ciesolka at a Darwin wharf, and learns how to cook her signature lemon citrus mud crab dish.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美前往偏遠的曼寧立達的阿納姆地沿海社區,在叢林中品嚐美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy travels to the remote Arnhem Land coastal community of Maningrida to get a taste of food out in the bush.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美在帕華普週末市集的檔攤品嚐達爾文的流行街頭小食;並討論達爾文對叻沙的迷戀.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy gets a taste of Darwins popular street food from the stalls of the Parap Saturday market; Jimmy discusses Darwins laksa obsession.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美跟卡卡杜的風景打卡;他與原住民梅曼迪聊天,他帶著佔美沿著黃水河遊船河飽覽她的國家.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy checks out the landscapes of Kakadu; he chats with traditional owner Mandy Muir who takes Jimmy to see her country on a boat trip along the Yellow Waters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在貝裡斯,詹姆斯與奧利弗·菲力普斯與阿爾菲·伊諾奇相聚.他們探索拉馬奈的瑪雅遺址,走訪水洞,了解門諾會文化,巡禮聖佩德羅的街頭美食,飛越藍洞,並在霍爾香珊瑚礁潛水.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: James and Oliver Phelps join Alfie Enoch in Belize. They explore Mayan ruins at Lamanai, visit water caves, learn about Mennonite culture, tour San Pedros street food, fly over the Blue Hole, and dive in the Hol Chan coral reefs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在新加坡,馬克·威廉士加入菲力普斯雙胞胎的行列,他們騎著側邊車穿越唐人街,體驗舞獅,並搭乘渡輪前往烏敏島劃劃皮艇穿梭紅樹林.在這趟刺激的旅程中,他們還深入探索了娘惹文化,歷史文物與在地美食.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Joined by Mark Williams in Singapore, the Phelps twins ride sidecars through Chinatown, try Lion Dancing, and ferry to Pulau Ubin to kayak the mangroves. They also explore Peranakan culture, artifacts, and local cuisine on this thrilling trip.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與嘉賓柯瑞·米克利斯特一起,詹姆斯和奧利弗造訪了墨爾本.他們遊覽雅拉河,觀賞菲利普島的小企鵝,駕駛卡丁車,乘坐普芬比利蒸汽火車,在貝爾斯海灘體驗衝浪課程,還在一架二戰老式飛機上上演空中特技.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: With guest Corey Mylchreest, James and Oliver explore Melbourne. They cruise the Yarra River, see Phillip Islands penguins, race go-karts, ride Puffing Billy, take a surf lesson at Bell’s Beach, and perform stunts in a WWII plane.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 達爾文唯一的朱古力師裡奧健弗斯帶佔美參觀自己的精品朱古力咖啡室- 蜜蜂豆豆朱古力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Darwins only chocolatier Leo Cleanthous shows Jimmy around his boutique chocolate cafe, Bumble Bean Chocolates.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 佔美參觀達爾文市中心,給自己的餐廳哈紐文一些建議,並烹製他兒時最喜歡的菜式之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jimmy visits the Darwin CBD to offer an insight into his own restaurant, Hanuman, and cooks one of his favourite childhood dishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入婆羅洲的心臟地帶,順著河流穿梭,翻山越嶺,探尋野生紅毛猩猩,侏儒象,長鼻猴,犀鳥與巨型昆蟲的蹤跡.這座島嶼擁有世界上最古老的原始熱帶雨林,以及極為豐富的生態系統.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deep dive into Borneo’s heartland forest, traveling up rivers and hills to spot wild orangutans, elephants, proboscis monkeys, hornbills, and giant insects. This island harbors the worlds oldest primary forest and a rich ecosystem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narrated by acclaimed English actor Bill Nighy, this blue-chip natural history series reveals the challenges faced by the astounding and rare creatures that make this unique environment their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由著名英國演員比爾奈伊聲音導航,這部優質的自然歷史系列揭示令人震驚和稀有的生物所面臨的挑戰,同時造就牠們家園獨特的環境.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭.變髒是工作的一部分.當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet the new wild warrior volunteers, as they are introduced to Imire’s extended animal family. Getting dirty is part of the job. And of course, there are always striking surprises at any moment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務.這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人.而且,總能忙裡偷閒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物.深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就.還有,努力無堅不摧.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episoden the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. Immersion into Imire’s anti-poaching efforts. And, nothing stands in the way of hard work.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想.茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然.例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this engaging episode, Reilly shares his rhino release dream. It’s time for Judy’s beloved duiker to return to the wild. And, a routine nyala capture takes an unexpected turn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯.來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事.是時候告別韋札的家人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, a warthog retrieval mission goes awry. Meet the matriarch of Imire, a wonderful elephant that has a unique story. It’s time to say farewell to the Imire family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".

But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. 
There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. 
White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks.  Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue.  She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Huang Yunong's Yunong Reptile Studio has an extraordinary passion for geckos and he regards every gecko as his own. He always feel sad when consumers buy them, just like saying goodbye to his own child. He always shares care knowledge in great detail, and cultivates concepts through his own experience to let more people know more about hem. He hopes that through "Cute Pets Coming", the overall gecko raising environment can continue to improve.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths – 416 animals perished. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: They’re beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They’re lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they’re wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic – all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Discover China is a documentary series shot in conjunction with the Chinese Ministry of Culture and China Central Television, including footage of never before seen locations and recreations of historical events. It was shot by BBC film crews over a four year period. At the foot of Tai Mountain sits an enigma, a temple that bears a striking resemblance to an Imperial palace. It was built by a brazen emperor, who ignored his country's desparation, and built this lavish shrine to bolster his status as the sole ruler.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The far-right political movement known as QAnon has taken off around the world, mobilising a committed band of believers dedicated to fighting what they claim is an ‘online war’ against corrupt, child abusing elites. In the United States, the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has declared QAnon a potential domestic terrorism threat. For one family, QAnon has caused division so severe that they had to report their relative - Tim Stewart, a QAnon conspiracy theorist - to Australia's national security hotline. In a concerning twist, it emerged that Stewart has had a longstanding friendship with Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison - leading to speculation about QAnon and Australia's highest ranks of political power. A look at the alarming movement which has caused ripples through the world, through the eyes of one family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc:
An intimate portrait of four very different suicide bombers working for Al Nusra in Syria. From the Saudi who loves singing and fried chicken to the 26-year-­old British convert who is worried about his new wife, this remarkable film embeds with an unlikely bunch of ‘martyrdom seekers’. As each waits for their turn to go on a final mission, known by jihadists as ‘Dugma’, this film lays bare the faith and doubt at the core of men who give their life for their cause.
Winner, Golden Nymph Award for Best Documentary - Festival du Television Monte Carlo 2017

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Born in different countries yet resembling each other so much, two women walked the path of life that was surprisingly similar. A baby girl was born in a small rural village of Jura in France. Her name is Colette. Another baby was born on the outskirt of Seoul, Korea. She is Sung-mi. Colette and Sung-mi wanted to live normal lives like any other women, but they couldn't because of visions and voices from deities which they have experienced since they were very young. They thought this was their divine punishments. After meeting each other at the 2014 International Shamanism Festival in France, Colette and Sung-mi realized that their special abilities could be something meaningful: they are gifts given from God to comfort and soothe the pain of other people. Finally, Colette and Sung-mi accepted their fates as shamans and began their spiritual journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: It's a term that's come to the fore in recent years, as the urgency of the climate crisis becomes increasingly apparent. "Greenwashing" is a troubling phenomenon in which companies which brand themselves as 'sustainable' - in hopes of attracting green investment - continue to cause massive pollution. For the corporations responsible for a vast proportion of global emissions, just what lies behind the promises of climate action?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: From no paid sick leave, to a reliance on tips in order to make a living, the COVID-19 pandemic has revealed the many fault lines in the American restaurant industry that affect both workers and consumers. As millions of restaurant workers were laid off in the face of the pandemic, Waging Change provides a behind the scenes look at what needs to change so that restaurant workers can receive a living wage once restaurants re-open. Featuring Saru Jayaraman, Lily Tomlin, Jane Fonda and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio Cortez, the film reveals two American workers’ struggles hidden in plain sight-- the effort to end the federal tipped minimum wage of $2.13 for restaurant servers and bartenders and the #MeToo movement's efforts to end sexual harassment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In 1953, Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay were the first to summit Mount Everest. That same year, the jetboat was invented. With this new invention, Hillary strove to also become the first to tackle the Himalayas' greatest river: the Ganges. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Spring 2014, armed pro-Russian rebels stormed the city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine. After seizing control of the city, the separatists held a referendum - labelled illegal by the US and EU - and independence from Kiev was declared. This brave documentary explores the origins and evolution of the Donetsk People's Republic, diving into hopeful beginnings and eventual descent into enduring conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.

So stop worrying and enjoy life". Finally, he finds himself immersed in God.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In Spring 2014, armed pro-Russian rebels stormed the city of Donetsk in eastern Ukraine. After seizing control of the city, the separatists held a referendum - labelled illegal by the US and EU - and independence from Kiev was declared. This brave documentary explores the origins and evolution of the Donetsk People's Republic, diving into hopeful beginnings and eventual descent into enduring conflict.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: On a hot August evening in the Lebanese capital of Beirut, a catastrophic explosion ripped through the city. It looked like a scene from a disaster movie, but it was real. As the shocking event unfolded, people around the city captured the moment, and its aftermath, on their phones. These videos soon went viral. This documentary tells the stories of many of those who filmed the blast as well as survivors whose experiences in the moment were dramatically captured onscreen. From a bride posing for her wedding photos when the explosion erupted, to divers at sea struck by the blast wave, to the young doctor tending to a woman in labour as the windows exploded inwards, each has an extraordinary story of survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: While many mainline Christian churches are in decline, Evangelical Christianity remains a powerful force in the 21st century. With 2.1 billion followers worldwide, this particular branch of faith must be doing something right. In this program, host Tevya enters the world of Evangelicals, meeting a local pastor whose weekly service is broadcast to five different locations and features a full rockband. He learns that it is all about giving back.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The White Island Volcano eruption in December 2019 claimed the lives of 23 people. Despite extraordinary stories of heroism in the rescue effort, could more have been done to prevent this awful loss of life? Terrified members of a boat trip to the New Zealand island watched on as a tower of smoke plumed from the mouth of the Volcano. It was not until they reached land that they realised the true horror of the situation. “Their skin just dripped off them like wax”, recounts a trained first-aider. Tour guide Hayden Marshall-Inman, who laid down his own life to stay behind and continue the rescue effort, is remembered fondly by his brother. “Hayden would always be the last man standing.” As time passes, grief has turned to anger. The victims' families are now building a judicial case against Royal Caribbean Cruises, claiming they did “absolutely nothing” to warn of the risks of a deadly eruption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Thousands of young people are dying from using drugs in Kachin State, Myanmar. A clash between “Pa Jasan” groups and drugs lords occurred.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Daily routines mark time for the children of Kenya’s Nchiru AIDS orphanage. Delving into the minutiae of their burgeoning lives, it is soon clear that amid their cheerful patter, death lurks in the shadows, as they cope with the loss of parents and friends and the exhausting struggle against HIV. A beautifully composed film that quietly grips its audience with a moving exploration of coming-of-age in rural Africa and the impact of HIV/AIDS.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The White Island Volcano eruption in December 2019 claimed the lives of 23 people. Despite extraordinary stories of heroism in the rescue effort, could more have been done to prevent this awful loss of life? Terrified members of a boat trip to the New Zealand island watched on as a tower of smoke plumed from the mouth of the Volcano. It was not until they reached land that they realised the true horror of the situation. “Their skin just dripped off them like wax”, recounts a trained first-aider. Tour guide Hayden Marshall-Inman, who laid down his own life to stay behind and continue the rescue effort, is remembered fondly by his brother. “Hayden would always be the last man standing.” As time passes, grief has turned to anger. The victims' families are now building a judicial case against Royal Caribbean Cruises, claiming they did “absolutely nothing” to warn of the risks of a deadly eruption.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Host Tevya goes deep into the woods to explore the spiritual ways of North America's first Aboriginal people- the people of the First Nations. After meeting two indigenous teenagers, Tevya experiences this religion firsthand.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: When Dian was six she narrowly escaped a tsunami of boiling mud that completely submerged 16 villages under a moonscape of grit, leaving 60,000 people displaced. Shot over six years, GRIT witnesses Dian's transformation in to a politically active teen, as she and her mother take on the perpetrators.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Investigative journalist Anthony Baxter travels between the US Presidential race and the Scottish countryside to chronicle the troubling confrontation between Donald Trump and a feisty 92-year-old widow, Molly Forbes, as she refuses to make way for his golf course. epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Born in different countries yet resembling each other so much, two women walked the path of life that was surprisingly similar. They thought this was their divine punishments. Finally, Colette and Sung-mi accepted their fates as shamans and began their spiritual journey.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Someone in Japan is in love with Switzerland, its culture, its folklore and, more specifically: the Swiss alphorn! The Tamagawa Alphorn Club from Nanasawa, Japan, is travelling to Switzerland to attend the International Alphorn Festival in Nendaz at the end of July. Alphorn playing started to be known in Japan in the 80ies and is becoming more and more popular in the last decade among retired people, but not only. Shigetoshi Nakagawa, founder of the group and a forest expert, is one of the first people who started to play the instrument; he has instructed to build and play the Alphorn in numerous regions, among children and elderly people. Thousands of Alphorn Clubs have been born lately and more and more Japanese are being interested in Swiss folklore culture and Switzerland in general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: K2 is widely seen as the world's harshest mountain. Yet many indigenous porters make a living in its extreme conditions, carrying provisions for foreign climbing expeditions. Often risking their lives with only rudimentary equipment, they receive minimal pay for their efforts. Against a backdrop of breathtaking natural beauty, this cinematic doc explores the everyday courage and sacrifice of the men who call the 'Savage Mountain' their home.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, its the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: The survivors work out how to call for help - but are faced with a treacherous climb; as some of the group begin to crack under the pressure, a third death - the most violent so far - warns that they are running out of time.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A commercial spaceflight company makes an announcement. The choice over wholl command the Mars mission leads to a shift in personnel.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jared enlists Simon, Mallory and a suspicious new ally to set traps for the creature in the Spiderwick Estate. Helen leads the search for Aunt Lucinda and grows closer to the enemy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 謝拉和西門找到他們的首個野外指南頁面,並在過程中建立意想不到的友諠.瑪洛莉努力在漢臣站穩陣腳,而海倫則忙著應付到訪的母親.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jared and Simon find their first field guide page and make unexpected friendships in the process. Mallory struggles to find her footing in Henson while Helen deals with her visiting mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為了登上塔頂,又一次考驗擺在眼前. 為了攀登這座塔,我們失去了很多,也獲得了重要的東西. 接受這一切,跟隨你內心的指引繼續前進.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another test is held to reach the top of the tower.\nMuch has been lost and important things have been gained in order to climb the tower.\nAccept it all and move forward in the direction your feelings lead you.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 各種各樣的想法和意圖在混亂的最終試煉場上交織在一起. 在巨大的陰謀擺佈下,戰士們勇敢地在戰場上奔跑. 當試煉達到高潮時,巴姆會向蕾切爾展現出怎樣的決心?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: All manner of thoughts and intentions intersect at the chaotic final testing ground.\nWhile tossed about by a giant plot, the combatants boldly race across the battlefield.\nAs the test reaches its climax, what resolve will Bam show to Rachel?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在反覆出現的夢境指引下,塞斯試圖潛入凱斯林·梅林的檔案館.在那裡,他得知了關於幽靈復仇女神起源的黑暗真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Guided by a reoccurring dream, Seth attempts to sneak into the archives at Caislean Merlin. Here, he learns a dark truth about the origins of the Spectral Nemesis.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯拼命掙扎,試圖擺脫迪亞巴爾的控制.與此同時,格林在一場衝突中身負重傷.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth hangs on for dear life as he attempts to escape the Diabals grasp. Meanwhile, Grimm is badly wounded in an altercation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞思僥倖逃出城堡,但身負重傷.梅莉察覺到賽斯有危險,便和醫生,奧科霍一起出發尋找他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth narrowly escapes the castle, but is badly wounded. Melie senses that Seth is in trouble and heads out with Doc and Ocoho to search for him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰.導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In The Worlds End, Simon Pegg and Nick Frost reunite for an epic pub crawl that turns into a fight for humanitys future. Director Edgar Wright delivers a hilarious mix of nostalgia, comedy, and sci-fi thrills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克裡斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末.起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬--直到令人不安的真相浮出水面.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her familys estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship-until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在 NASA 全力準備火星發射之際,瑪戈卻面臨著殘酷的個人現實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As NASA scrambles to prepare for the launch to Mars, Margo is confronted with a harsh personal reality.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Air authorities search desperately for the plane and federal agencies spring into action; as the group becomes smaller and smaller, the last survivors know they are going to have to fight to stay alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 就在守護者考驗即將結束時,巴姆被蕾切爾推了下去. 時間倒流至塔門開啟之時. 巴姆是如何度過這段時間的?蕾切爾看到的又是怎樣的世界?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Just as the guardians test is about to end, Bam is pushed off by Rachel.\nTime turns back to when the towers doors opened.\nHow did Bam spend his time? What is the world Rachel saw?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞思僥倖逃出城堡,但身負重傷.梅莉察覺到賽斯有危險,便和醫生,奧科霍一起出發尋找他.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth narrowly escapes the castle, but is badly wounded. Melie senses that Seth is in trouble and heads out with Doc and Ocoho to search for him.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 奧科霍和梅莉因在上一場戰鬥中違抗命令而受到指責,但莫德雷德告訴女王這一切都是布朗戈爾領主的失誤,從而救了她們.同時,塞斯繼續訓練,以便學會控制自己的力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ocoho and Melie are blamed for disobeying orders in the previous battle, but Mordred saves them by telling the queen that it was all Lord Brangoires mistake. Seth, meanwhile, continues training so that he can learn to control his power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 塞斯繼續接受米爾和吉爾的嚴格訓練,以期控制自己的力量.同時,面對即將到來的復仇女神威脅,騎士巫師們被迫接受德·吉利斯領主的援助,展開緊急行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Seth continues his rigorous training with Myr and Jill so that he can control his powers. Meanwhile, the Knight-Sorcerers are forced to accept the aid of Lord de Guilis during an emergency operation on an approaching Nemesis threat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在回到未來 III中,馬蒂穿越回1885年,從亡命之徒手中救了博士.這部影片充滿了笑話,動作和感人肺腑的劇情,是這部備受喜愛的三部曲史詩般的西部大結局.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Back to the Future Part III, Marty travels to 1885 to save Doc from an outlaw. Packed with laughs, action, and heart, its the epic Wild West finale to the beloved trilogy.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 凱特和祖正考慮試管嬰兒,但17年前棄養的孩子卻出現.丹妮卡搬去和凱特同住,隨時間漸過,裂痕漸生,她真的是凱特的女兒嗎?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kate and Joe are considering in-vitro options when a child Kate gave up 17 years ago resurfaces. Danica moves in with Kate and as time passes, cracks begin to appear, is she really Kates daughter?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿諾史瓦辛格在魔鬼孩子王中飾演強悍的偵探約翰金布爾,他臥底成為一名教師,以尋找毒梟的妻子.這部經典的喜劇驚悚片充滿了動作,幽默和感人.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Arnold Schwarzenegger stars as tough detective John Kimble in Kindergarten Cop, going undercover as a teacher to find a drug lords wife. Packed with action, humor, and heart, its a classic comedy-thriller.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前中情局分析員賴利康納揭露中情局的不當行為,並逃往哥倫比亞兩年,被她的老搭檔帶回來執行最後一項任務,以洗擦汙名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two years after exposing CIA wrongdoing and fleeing to Colombia, ex-CIA analyst Riley Connor is brought back in by her old partner for one last assignment in order to clear her name.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在反恐戰場中,傑米福克斯率領一支菁英FBI小組前往沙烏地阿拉伯追捕一名恐怖分子--這是一場文化與正義的緊張交鋒.該片由彼得柏格執導,麥可曼監製.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: A deer hunter in the New Zealand mountains stumbles upon a WWII aircraft wreckage containing a massive cash cache. A violent race erupts when a ruthless gang of treasure hunters discovers the site to claim the fortune.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 施惠國的每個地區在一年一度的飢餓遊戲比賽都必須送出一男一女決一死戰.珍妮花羅倫絲飾演16歲的凱妮絲艾弗丁,她自願代替妹妹參加比賽.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every district in the nation of Panem must send a boy and girl to fight to the death in the annual Hunger Games competition. Jennifer Lawrence is 16-year-old Katniss Everdeen, who volunteers to take her younger sister’s place in the games.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫.當軍方無力介入,政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名忠誠的丈夫,軍人,三個孩子的父親,親自打電話向警方做出毛骨悚然的自白:他射殺了自己的妻子.原本看似單純的凶殺案,很快就演變成更加複雜的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A devoted husband, military man, and father of three calls the police with a chilling confession: he’s shot his wife. What first appears to be a straightforward homicide soon unravels into something far more complex.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當黛安娜.巴羅被發現失去意識時,家屬與警方起初認為她死於自然原因,直到小鎮流言揭露,鄰里中的罪犯可能隱藏著致命祕密.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A massive changeover rocks the boat. A stew gets pulled in multiple and a flirty love triangle starts to heat up. The chef struggles to cater to vegan guests with particular palates and complaints.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾的新盟友(後轉為室友)考驗著阿曼達的耐心.米格爾在墨西哥尋找親生父親.泰瑞則開始對眼鏡蛇道館進行大改造.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniels new ally-turned-housemate tests Amandas patience. Miguel searches for his father in Mexico. Terry starts to transform Cobra Kai.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 喬善和丹尼爾策劃了一個針對泰瑞的冒險計畫.在墨西哥,羅比和強尼正在尋找米格爾,而米格爾發現了關於他父親的真相.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chozen and Daniel hatch a risky plot against Terry. In Mexico, Robby and Johnny look for Miguel, who discovers the truth about his dad.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾過去的另一個敵人重新浮出水面.經過一天的 SPA 水療和一番內心掙扎後,珊對於她與米格爾的未來做出了決定.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Another enemy from Daniels past resurfaces. After a spa day and some soul-searching, Sam comes to a decision about her future with Miguel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 強尼和卡門的情事進展順利,而丹尼爾和阿曼達則被泰瑞的陰謀搞得心神不寧.青少年們的恩怨延燒到了水上樂園.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johnny and Carmens romance flies high while Daniel and Amanda are rattled by Terrys schemes. The teens feuds spill over at the waterpark.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 丹尼爾依靠一位朋友--也是亦敵亦友的夥伴.米格爾和羅比的緊張關係達到頂點.一張熟悉的面孔回歸了.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Daniel leans on a friend - and frenemy. Tensions come to a head for Miguel and Robby. A familiar face returns.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 泰瑞招募了一位精通拳法之道的專家.丹尼爾選擇遠離紛爭,強尼和喬善卻主動挑起戰火.在監獄裡,克里斯正視著內心的心魔.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Terry recruits an expert in the way of the fist. Daniel walks away from a fight, and Johnny and Chozen pick one. In prison, Kreese confronts old demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 泰瑞和金發起了一項殘酷的挑戰,而喬善則教導他的學生們不同的一課.強尼和丹尼爾要求克里斯給出交代.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Terry and Kim issue a brutal challenge while Chozen teaches his students a different kind of lesson. Johnny and Daniel demand answers from Kreese.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個爭奪國際頂尖賽事名額的機會引發了道館間的激戰.多莉的忠誠度受到考驗.珊則難以放下米格爾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A coveted spot in an elite international tournament ignites a fight between dojos. Torys loyalties are tested. Sam struggles to let Miguel go.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在戰後的日本,哥吉拉的出現為滿目瘡痍的國土帶來了新的浩劫.當軍方無力介入,政府束手無策之際,倖存者們必須在絕望中團結起來,迎戰這股無情的恐怖力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一家火災受害者被緊急送往加夫尼醫院.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A family of victims from a house fire are rushed to Gaffney.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當里普利與阿徹在一起不尋常病例的治療方案上產生分歧時,事情演變成了私人恩怨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Things get personal when Ripley and Archer butt heads over the treatment plans tied to an unusual case.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢娜治癒了一位患有未確診疾病的女性,該病症同時威脅著她與腹中胎兒的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hannah treats a woman whose undiagnosed condition threatens the lives of both her and her unborn child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查理斯分秒必爭地說服一名患者在為時已晚之前接受治療.佛洛斯特與一位正與免疫缺陷奮戰的小女孩建立了深厚的情誼.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Charles races to convince a patient to accept treatment before it’s too late. Frost bonds with a young girl battling immunodeficiency.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 艾雪與阿徹之間的私人衝突達到了爆發點.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A personal clash between Asher and Archer reaches a breaking point.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當古德溫的家人為波特聚在一起時,秘密隨之揭開.里普利與佛洛斯特則在樹屋治療兩名被胡蜂螫傷的孩童.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Secrets are uncovered when Goodwin’s family comes together for Bert. Ripley and Frost treat two children stung by hornets in a treehouse.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查爾斯對一位同事的意圖愈發感到懷疑.倫諾克斯為了保護一名患者而越過了底線.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Charles grows increasingly suspicious of a colleague’s intentions. Lenox crosses a line to protect a patient.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 醫生們正面對因停電期間所做抉擇而引發的職場與個人後效.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The doctors deal with the professional and personal fallout from the choices made during a power outage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起路怒事件將三名患者送進急診室,導致緊張局勢急遽升溫.弗羅斯特以前的電視搭檔再度現身.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tensions spike when a road-rage incident sends three patients into the E.D. Frost’s former television co-star resurfaces.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿徹與弗羅斯特在治療一名大學籃球員時,面臨了一個令人困惑的醫學謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Archer and Frost confront a troubling medical mystery while treating a college basketball player.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當查爾斯醫學院最好的朋友來訪時,勾起了他的陳年恩怨.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Old resentment stirs up Charles when his best friends from med school visit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當三名醫學生跟隨查爾斯實習一天時,他面臨了新的挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Charles faces a new challenge when three medical students shadow him for a day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蓋夫尼醫院的醫生們陷入了一場與時間的賽跑,努力解開一個與客機有關,令人困惑的醫學謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The doctors at Gaffney are thrust into a race against time as they work to unravel a baffling medical mystery linked to the passenger jet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿徹和萊諾克斯治療了兩名在聖派翠克節慶祝活動中受傷的朋友.漢娜和里普利則治療了一名正處於棘手離婚官司中的女子.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Archer and Lenox treat two friends who were injured in St. Patricks Day festivities. Hannah and Ripley treat a woman in the middle of a messy divorce.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿徹在處理一起複雜病例時,不得不直面自己的生死存亡.一名患者的古怪習慣讓查爾斯和西奧大惑不解.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Archer confronts his own mortality while on a complex case. One patient’s quirky habit baffles Charles and Theo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 阿徹在處理一起複雜病例時,不得不直面自己的生死存亡.一名患者的古怪習慣讓查爾斯和西奧大惑不解.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Archer confronts his own mortality while on a complex case. One patient’s quirky habit baffles Charles and Theo.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 查爾斯醫生在一段自殺防治專線工作的慘痛經歷後,開始努力應對自身的心理健康問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dr. Charles grapples with his own mental health following a harrowing experience working the suicide prevention line.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 加夫尼醫院的醫生們全力以赴,拯救一名處於極度危險中的同僚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The doctors at Gaffney work to save one of their own in critical danger.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場可怕的車禍讓一個家庭的命運落在了加夫尼醫院醫護人員的手中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A horrific car accident puts a family’s fate in the hands of the Gaffney staff.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名病患危險且複雜的分娩過程,迫使漢娜正面面對自己的過去.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A patient’s dangerous and complicated labor forces Hannah to confront her past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蓋夫尼醫院遭遇監獄暴動,急診室瞬間陷入一片混亂.古德溫與查爾斯則為一場至關重要的董事會會議做準備.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gaffney is thrown into chaos when a prison riot overwhelms the E.D. Goodwin and Charles prepare for a high-stakes board meeting.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漢娜迎來了她職業生涯中最具挑戰性的接生任務之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hannah faces one of the most challenging deliveries of her career.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 眾星分途展開「社企打工王」生涯！劉佩玥先後出任有機農場的導賞員、食物加工廠工人與健康食品店售貨員，領略為精神病康復者提供培訓及就業機會的社企「一條龍」運作模式，並感嘆小小豆腐成品的繁複製作步驟！黃嘉樂前往主要服務長者的有聲書製作基地，體驗錄音樂趣之餘，還到商場推廣這些「靚聲」產品，表現如何？有社企藉回收及義賣物品，幫助低收入家庭。張振朗從收集捐贈品後分類，親身到店舖推銷貨品，實踐環保扶貧的理念。
三位「星級」藝員接力執行「打工王」任務。麥美恩來到為中年婦女提供就業機會的二手女裝與童裝店出任售貨員，卻看漏眼接收了因破損不宜寄賣的衣物，怎樣收科？張彥博在招請更新人士的社企餐廳當侍應，未幾即打破餐碟，唯有虛心向同事請教托盤技巧。他又幫忙準備乳豬菜式及窩夫甜品；功夫雖未到家，勝在待客態度親切！有電單車行以社企形式經營，協助戒毒康復者重投社會。何君誠前往上班，能否成為稱職的電單車維修員及銷售代表？
袁偉豪與王君馨、蔡思貝和余德丞前來比拼，哪對「螢幕情侶」智勝一籌？東京田園風商舖深受少女歡迎，當中主打的環保產品是甚麼？法式料理店主熱愛大自然，還採用冷門材料炮製一系列菜式，讓「問題專員」鄺潔楹食指大動！哥倫比亞黃金博物館展出不少黃金製品，偉豪猜測其中一件尖形物品為「護弟罩」，是錯是對？吉隆坡仙四師爺廟可供信徒「求藥」，求籤者要獲得藥方，卻有特別方法！兌換匯率環節，竟有一隊獲得個位數字獎金……
自由書寫藝術家認為文字內容是永恆的記憶，她享受如刺繡般緩慢的創作過程，更顯出有溫度的文字。她將日常觀察、思考的習慣，演變成一種生活方式。編織藝術家採用回收的素材如漂流木創作飾物。編織藝術為她擺脫低潮，她亦視編織為靜心的過程。她相信人不應局限於框架，而是獨一無二的。金工藝術家拋開金工製作常規，保留了金屬被火燒過後的紋理線條。她的成長經歷影響她對美醜的想法，認為別人覺得不好看的東西，都有其獨特一面。
街拍攝影藝術家的作品圍繞街拍、公路攝影、人物寫真。攝影集「台北無聊風景」怎麼令人猜不透？作品呈現他對故鄉台北的印象，經過相片的回憶，富有懷舊感覺。布花設計藝術家運用「色塊」與「線條」呈現不同的城市景色，從作品中可找到鐵皮屋、稻田、地磚圖案特色的布藝。通過手作，藝術家將景物的原始狀態留下來。紙膠帶藝術家的創作靈感來自日常生活，將台灣日常風景如鐵窗花變成符號呈現出來，她亦細說作品中的「介面」設計。
星夢頻道樂園有新商場開張，未來等人到場一探究竟，發現那正舉行購物測試活動，吉祥物需要就「加深與主人關係」這個題目，以3000硬幣進行一場購物比賽。第一次花錢購物，一眾吉祥物都不知從何入手，更為此絞盡腦汁。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 多啦美難得買到一直想吃的頂級蜜瓜包，卻被多啦Ａ夢擅自吃了。兄妹二人因此吵架。天氣寒冷，大雄不想出外，只想睡覺，還責怪地球的日間時間太長。見此，多啦Ａ夢用法寶幫大雄塑造一個理想的星球。
一名高中拳擊界新星在比賽中受了重傷，運動員生涯可能要劃上句號。為了復出，他接受了某個手術，而條件是入讀私立葛洛利亞學園。轉學第一天，他向學園的體育科叩門，卻沒想到，自己被分派到的竟是音樂科……

epg.programme_title_tc: 盲盒鐵路遊[粵] 及 無煙新進程[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Blind Travel by Rail[Can] and Tobacco-Free Journey: The New Phase[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在哈爾濱的室內滑雪場，貫東挑戰人生首次滑雪；丁丁試圖展現帥氣一面，卻被德德吐槽對他失望？盲盒指令前往中國最北端的漠河，經鐵路再自駕，終點是中俄邊境交界？德德的手機訊號更一度越界！兩男將德德蒙眼帶到神秘地點，德德本不停驚慌尖叫，摘下眼罩環顧四周卻感覺夢幻，原來她正被一群馴鹿包圍。品嚐柴火燒製的鐵鍋燉，配以一碟鍋包肉，是地道的東北滋味。躺坐於星空下，三主持邊等待極光，邊互訴旅程感受與心底話，場面溫馨。

溏心鮑魚是高級粵菜經典，行政總廚黃隆滔盡得師父楊貫一真傳，他教大家從產地、陳年程度、燜法轉變認識乾鮑。回想三十年師徒情，黃師傅大為感觸。芷珊細味軟糯溏心的鎮店網鮑，嚐出滿滿幸福感！粉麵店主理人劉蘇女用心製作潮式魚蛋多年，並由兒子接棒，承傳手唧香蔥魚蛋的魚香、鬆化口感。冰是魚蛋起膠關鍵？前「摘星級」燒味主廚陳寶成自立門戶，為街坊炮製脆皮燒鵝。燒鵝脆而不膩，必經醃味、上皮、入爐步驟，他還細心切走肥膏。

李文星身為中菜國際餐飲集團行政總廚，堅信味道才是留住客人的不二法門。他不計較工序繁複，逐一替鴨身充氣，只為讓食客嚐到更鬆化的片皮鴨。星哥多年來始終以食客角度出發，這信念不僅令他當年獲得五星級酒店肯定，更奠定日後的輝煌成就。港式代表美食之一車仔麵，深水埗名店每款餸皆用心備料、烹調，主理人還列出豬腸等五款「考牌」餸菜。謝寧從香港小姐「變成」蝴蝶酥女王，但她仍不自滿，持續研發新口味，近年更榮獲國際大獎。
一向注重飲食均衡的Gigi姐，本集會介紹中西合璧的竹笙午餐肉；除了菜名中的兩種食材，還會搭配冬菇、蘆筍和蝦肉，一道菜就包含了蔬菜、肉類、菇類和海鮮。為求美觀，Gigi姐更會仔細介紹各種食材的處理方法。

epg.programme_title_tc: PPA亞洲職業匹克球巡迴賽1500 •恒生銀行香港大滿貫2026[直播][粵]
epg.programme_title_en: PPA Asia 1500, Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam 2026[LIVE][Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港大滿貫於2026年10月下旬假啟德體藝館舉行，是2026年PPA亞洲職業匹克球巡迴賽的賽季壓軸賽事，也是亞洲規模最大的職業匹克球錦標賽，眾好手將角逐各個項目的冠軍、1500積分，以及110萬美元的總獎金。TVB於10月25日(星期日)的賽事決賽日，送上精選比拼，讓觀眾感受匹克球運動帶來的刺激魅力！
如果覺得身邊人做得好，不妨多一點讚美，讓人更有自信。本集「My Little Show」，兩位表演者的表現，又能否獲得觀眾讚賞？11歲女生熱愛唱歌，這次帶來經典音樂劇的歌曲，高音要唱得既動聽又穩定，箇中有何技巧？另一位10歲女生也帶來音樂表演，她以輕便的長笛，吹奏出舒伯特的經典樂曲，清脆悅耳。人生是一場大冒險，結他導師與兩位主持先走入<綠野仙踪>的歌曲意境，再勇敢探索人生眾多的<未知道>。
改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！
中野先生因太太外遊而感到寂寞，為了排解寂寞，他常到小丸子家作客，並變得比平時多話。友藏收到兒時好友阿薰來信，兩人時隔六十年重逢，並憑藉一架舊玩具車重拾珍貴友情與童年回憶。
人工智能及機械人技術，繼續是今年秋季電子展的焦點主題，來自不同地方的參展商，如何將最新的技術，應用在不同場景的消費電子產品上，最新的市場趨勢會如何？
翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

epg.programme_title_en: Nong's Shen Ling Bai Shu San Pres:Weather Report[Can]

epg.programme_title_en: Sunday Report[Can] and Tobacco-Free Journey: The New Phase[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港這個國際大都會，在繁華背後仍然保留不少歷史悠久的傳統鄉村，當中在港島區就有過二百多年的鄉村薄扶林村，是港島三大古老鄉村之一；在新界亦有一條逾千年歷史的錦田村。本集將會穿梭村落，了解鄉村的節慶習俗及傳統文化。適逢今年為新界鄉議局成立一百周年，亦將會探討這百年來的變遷，同時探討社會大眾保育村落文化的情況。
《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

epg.programme_title_tc: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: China Citic Bank International Motion$ Presents:Try It? Really? (Sr.2)[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幫襯按摩店，竟見主持們被技師用刀剁全身，GM更需獻出尊容「受刑」，最終評價如何？來到零冷氣、只能坐在店外的雞肉飯小店，大家縱汗流浹背仍堅持用餐，究竟有多好吃？一間歡迎自攜食品的酒館，美儀姐要求振朗、坤哥、GM為她點一杯酒，再各自外出選購佐酒小食。三男分別買回台式滷味、鹽水雞、水餃等，坤哥卻要出奇謀討美儀姐歡心「補鑊」？振朗採購途中被台北民眾大讚似何家勁，看來「展昭」都是自帶一種難以掩蓋的「帥氣」！

epg.programme_title_tc: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2[粵]
epg.programme_title_en: Funki Finance Presents:A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 冷氣俊男智弘獲梁超怡挑選走進「心跳電話亭」，再次挑戰吃鞋帶糖，似要刷新紀錄。「情敵們」準備充足，各自出招冧珮文；真情剖白後玩鞋帶糖，某人出手遮掩戲肉部份？陳星妤點名型男共處親密時光，將頭緊貼男方心口，竟勾起前度的身影？沛珈與求愛男真誠交流解心結，對望、鼻碰鼻牽動心跳火花！「老對手」為得若思芳心，拉票時散發陣陣火藥味；頭貼心口製造浪漫畫面，男方震胸動盪女神？七位女神所得成績，將會決定下輪揀人次序……

epg.programme_title_tc: 及時雨信貸呈獻：一周星星[粵][PG]

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 子樂利用以盈進去文彬的公司調查DH2；董先生想把許森挖角，但被婉拒，許森更利用潔怡去調查董先生；嘉軒和家寶跟蹤金先生，家寶卻遭金先生襲擊；金先生再跟文彬見面，但文彬再表明單憑自己難以造出金先生需要的東西。
《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

話題劇《婚後事》引起熾熱討論，美恩先探問黎諾懿、賴慰玲共浴戲的「趣味」位，諾懿笑言要兼任道具手足！再向羅子溢、陳自瑤求證拍攝激情場口時，眼睛「關注」的視點；為何自瑤不斷大讚對手？繼而討論精神、肉體出軌，男女看法大不同，子溢一下「見風轉舵」舉動，還證明他深懂夫妻相處之道。拜劇集監製所賜，美恩可率先收看大結局，慰玲、諾懿卻指可能有第二個結局？美恩更天馬行空，隨即想出相關「第三個結局」及延續，絕對夠爆！

世上職業何其多，美恩先讓拍檔曾展望(GM)從外表猜猜三位嘉賓的職業。全職Cosplayer因興趣入行，寫真模特兒又何以成為A片女優？也有學生哥為幫人而在網上開設「萬事屋」。各嘉賓如何計算收入？美恩聽後竟有興趣轉職？進一步認識三個職業，特殊裝扮曾引「路人」在鐵路站求婚！美恩好奇AV界「潛規則」，寶島個別男優做過甚麼卑劣行為？萬事屋有求必應，簡單如排籌都可光顧！嘉賓們又是如何用心工作，換取家人的支持？
Louis邀丁子朗與林穎彤、朱智賢和林秀怡到「魔術酒吧」，並讀心變出各人想要的飲品。茶壺加水，竟接連倒出紅酒、白酒和橙汁？朱朱另即場通過味覺測試後，被盈盈「施術」改變味蕾，新鮮檸檬卻可嚐到甜味？除了「味覺轉移」，能量都可轉移。觸碰冰塊、蠟燭的冷熱體感完全對調，把硬幣、紙巾分別置於兩者之上更有神奇變化！依婷則揚言可將假手與丁丁的手連結，當假手放近火焰，丁丁竟有被燙燒的感覺，異常體驗是魔術還是科學？
譚嘉儀、周志康組隊亮相，身為Louis老拍檔的Bob林盛斌則偕戴祖儀前來，更揚言要魔術大踢爆！Louis吸收電蚊拍的電能，向女嘉賓放電，還電到木板現閃電符號。「發電機」盈盈藉檸檬陣為嘉儀手機充電，Bob扮專家以科學解謎，可有根據？七巧板朱古力食得又玩得，Louis偷食板塊後再重組，七巧板卻神奇回復原狀？一大疊發泡膠杯竟可放進「無底」收納盒，Bob與志康對依婷的表演各有見解，更以吞掉盒蓋作賭注……

嘉賓賴慰玲擁有「食極唔肥」的天賦特質，讓她能隨心所欲享用各式甜品。古嘉俊製作甜品功力深厚不容置疑，他的作品卻不一定是人見人愛，皆因阿古今次選用大眾對之「愛恨分明」、並非人人受落的食材─ 榴槤，炮製一款口味別出心裁的「榴槤朱古力」。甜美的朱古力幾乎人見人愛，製作優質朱古力需要精確配合每種食材的微小特性，除了考慮朱古力濃度之外，食材出產地對口味同樣也大有影響，且看阿古如何駕馭榴槤這刁鑽食材，與之配搭！

在哈爾濱的室內滑雪場，貫東挑戰人生首次滑雪；丁丁試圖展現帥氣一面，卻被德德吐槽對他失望？盲盒指令前往中國最北端的漠河，經鐵路再自駕，終點是中俄邊境交界？德德的手機訊號更一度越界！兩男將德德蒙眼帶到神秘地點，德德本不停驚慌尖叫，摘下眼罩環顧四周卻感覺夢幻，原來她正被一群馴鹿包圍。品嚐柴火燒製的鐵鍋燉，配以一碟鍋包肉，是地道的東北滋味。躺坐於星空下，三主持邊等待極光，邊互訴旅程感受與心底話，場面溫馨。

溏心鮑魚是高級粵菜經典，行政總廚黃隆滔盡得師父楊貫一真傳，他教大家從產地、陳年程度、燜法轉變認識乾鮑。回想三十年師徒情，黃師傅大為感觸。芷珊細味軟糯溏心的鎮店網鮑，嚐出滿滿幸福感！粉麵店主理人劉蘇女用心製作潮式魚蛋多年，並由兒子接棒，承傳手唧香蔥魚蛋的魚香、鬆化口感。冰是魚蛋起膠關鍵？前「摘星級」燒味主廚陳寶成自立門戶，為街坊炮製脆皮燒鵝。燒鵝脆而不膩，必經醃味、上皮、入爐步驟，他還細心切走肥膏。

李文星身為中菜國際餐飲集團行政總廚，堅信味道才是留住客人的不二法門。他不計較工序繁複，逐一替鴨身充氣，只為讓食客嚐到更鬆化的片皮鴨。星哥多年來始終以食客角度出發，這信念不僅令他當年獲得五星級酒店肯定，更奠定日後的輝煌成就。港式代表美食之一車仔麵，深水埗名店每款餸皆用心備料、烹調，主理人還列出豬腸等五款「考牌」餸菜。謝寧從香港小姐「變成」蝴蝶酥女王，但她仍不自滿，持續研發新口味，近年更榮獲國際大獎。
自由書寫藝術家認為文字內容是永恆的記憶，她享受如刺繡般緩慢的創作過程，更顯出有溫度的文字。她將日常觀察、思考的習慣，演變成一種生活方式。編織藝術家採用回收的素材如漂流木創作飾物。編織藝術為她擺脫低潮，她亦視編織為靜心的過程。她相信人不應局限於框架，而是獨一無二的。金工藝術家拋開金工製作常規，保留了金屬被火燒過後的紋理線條。她的成長經歷影響她對美醜的想法，認為別人覺得不好看的東西，都有其獨特一面。
街拍攝影藝術家的作品圍繞街拍、公路攝影、人物寫真。攝影集「台北無聊風景」怎麼令人猜不透？作品呈現他對故鄉台北的印象，經過相片的回憶，富有懷舊感覺。布花設計藝術家運用「色塊」與「線條」呈現不同的城市景色，從作品中可找到鐵皮屋、稻田、地磚圖案特色的布藝。通過手作，藝術家將景物的原始狀態留下來。紙膠帶藝術家的創作靈感來自日常生活，將台灣日常風景如鐵窗花變成符號呈現出來，她亦細說作品中的「介面」設計。

桃夭逃走時無意中躲進賈逢源的馬車，求他相救。陳伯遠登門來要人，賈逢源假意答應，把他毒暈，撕毀了桃夭的賣身契。百草先生告訴姚滴珠孫俊豪喜歡她，滴珠故意悉心打扮引來狂蜂浪蝶，想用激將法逼孫俊豪表白心意。

epg.programme_title_en: SCOLAR 30 years on: A Language Education Journey[Can]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 「深耕三十載 ，語你譜新篇」，教育局、語文教育及研究常務委員會(語常會)三十年來，致力協助在香港推動兩文三語。節目由星級藝員梁凱晴(Carina)、焦浩軒、語常會學生語文大使Anisah Hussain擔綱演出，述說當局如何透過政策藍圖、撥款、教學支援、多元化活動等各方面，讓本港市民，尤其是中小學生提升語文水平，進一步掌握兩文三語的運用。

雙腳併合站立時，兩膝之間有大空隙，可能是「O型腳」表徵，骨科醫生卻指O型腳也有真與假？醫生補充，站着照X光就一清二楚。如出現症狀，初期患者宜多做運動及減肥。陳美齡既是歌手，也是作家、教育家，她細談年屆七十仍忙出書、出歌的原因，鼓勵大家不要受年齡限制，並享受現在和追夢。而保持開朗心情、獨特步姿正確、清空煩惱助入眠，都是其長壽秘訣，想美就可從五色五味飲食方法着手。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「藜麥燜雞」。
望子成龍是每位父母的必然期望，但藉着基因編輯技術能否孕育出「天才BB」？婦產科專科醫生與心理學家均指人類基因結構複雜，人為編輯可能引致災難性後果，嘉賓黎諾懿、葉翠翠與Bob的太太又有何見解？新興的基因測試技術可檢測BB潛能，節目首集情商Bob的兒子充當「測試專員」。除了虎媽、象媽與直升機父母，近期還出現「海豚媽」一詞，究竟是甚麼教育風格？Bob嫂不諱言擁有虎媽特質，更奉行「高壓式講道理」主義？
尤長與秋水談起來，才知雙方也被騙。秋水陪尤長出席活動，芭芭拉宣布辭去所有公職，並指秋水才是真正尤太。在野向靜雯表白。秋水的區議員席位進行補選，在野參選，而靜雯亦被推舉參選，在野想盡辦法助靜雯退選。
